Comic/Bonus_Page10_Bubble_1: Miss Forneus is so nice… she let us sleep in her son's beds. She told us they’re travelling, but sometimes they come back and see her.
Comic/Bonus_Page10_Bubble_3: This silkworm told me my outfit was ugly
Comic/Bonus_Page11_Bubble_1: We came across these old guys playing dice.
Comic/Bonus_Page11_Bubble_2: I won 5 Coins! And then Rinor lost them again.
Comic/Bonus_Page11_Bubble_4: Another weird bird guy… we ran away as soon as we saw him.
Comic/Bonus_Page11_Bubble_5: I wanted an axe! So unfair…
Comic/Bonus_Page12_Bubble_1: Where the Leader holds Sermons. Kinda smells like hay…
Comic/Bonus_Page12_Bubble_2: This is where we pray to the Lamb. We have to pray a lot!
Comic/Bonus_Page12_Bubble_3: I share a shelter with Rinor and Yarlen- I mean Stinky!
Comic/Bonus_Page12_Bubble_4: My job is to look after the farm. Rinor chops wood!
Comic/Bonus_Page12_Bubble_6: Everyone poops everywhere, all the time.
Comic/Bonus_Page13_Bubble_1: This is the Lamb. They are our Leader.
Comic/Bonus_Page13_Bubble_2: They’re a bit scary… but they’re nice.
Comic/Bonus_Page13_Bubble_4: It has a flower on it…
Comic/Bonus_Page13_Bubble_5: How did they know I love flowers?
Comic/Bonus_Page14_Bubble_2: You weren’t supposed to see this!
Comic/Bonus_Page1_Bubble_1: I’m glad my journal mostly survived…
Comic/Bonus_Page1_Bubble_11: I’ve never seen some of these creatures before.
Comic/Bonus_Page1_Bubble_3: We should go to Spore Grotto! You gotta meet a Mushroomo!
Comic/Bonus_Page1_Bubble_4: Someone told me paradise was around here…
Comic/Bonus_Page1_Bubble_5: This is where I grew up!
Comic/Bonus_Page1_Bubble_7: This place is so weird… where’s Yarlen?
Comic/Bonus_Page1_Bubble_8: For a skunk, I thought Rinor would be stinky. She’s really nice…
Comic/Bonus_Page1_Bubble_9: These guys are really obsessed with light… think they worship the lighthouse?
Comic/Bonus_Page2_Bubble_3: Where do those legs come from?
Comic/Bonus_Page2_Bubble_4: The more I think about the Fish-fisherman guy, the creepier it becomes.
Comic/Bonus_Page3_Bubble_1: How do these flowers grow so big…?
Comic/Bonus_Page3_Bubble_3: Rinor used to live in Darkwood. She says that it belongs to Bishop Leshy, the Worm. Why would a worm be in charge?
Comic/Bonus_Page3_Bubble_6: We passed some village ruins. I asked Rinor what had happened but… she didn’t want to talk about it.
Comic/Bonus_Page6_Bubble_1: The Bishop here is called Kallamar. Rinor hasn’t seen him before.
Comic/Bonus_Page6_Bubble_2: I heard he’s a big squid!
Comic/Bonus_Page7_Bubble_2: This guy is so creepy… he wouldn’t even give us directions without getting paid!
Comic/Bonus_Page7_Bubble_3: I could hear something whispering at the bottom of this well…
Comic/Bonus_Page8_Bubble_2: The wood here is blue! So weird!
Comic/Bonus_Page8_Bubble_3: Apparently if you wear this, you won’t be able to sleep. I think that sounds terrible, but Rinor thinks it would be fun.
Comic/Bonus_Page8_Bubble_4: You could do so much more stuff!
Comic/Bonus_Page9_Bubble_6: Special: Rakshasa’s Secret Stew! He wouldn’t tell us what was in it…
Comic/Bonus_Page9_Bubble_7: Free Grape Nectar with every meal!
Comic/Page10_Bubble_2: of a wicked beast that stalks these Lands…
Comic/Page10_Bubble_6: A beast that devours anyone and anything in its path,
Comic/Page10_Bubble_7: its thirst for blood never satiated.
Comic/Page11_Bubble_2: The beast isn’t real, it’s just a rumour.
Comic/Page11_Bubble_5: we have a lot of walking to do-
Comic/Page12_Bubble_11: Who dares trespass on the land of the Bishop Leshy?
Comic/Page12_Bubble_6: That damned beast always gets there first.
Comic/Page12_Bubble_8: What if we can’t find a sacrifice?
Comic/Page12_Bubble_9: Then one of us will have the honour of laying our life before Leshy
Comic/Page14_Bubble_2: You will serve the Bishop well.
Comic/Page17-1_Bubble_1: Small creature from o’er the sea…
Comic/Page18-1_Bubble_3: Does fate grow as the flowers do, or is it built by mortal hand?
Comic/Page19-1_Bubble_1: In the hiding, you seek. In the rips and tides of the ether, you are but less than a drop.
Comic/Page19-1_Bubble_2: Some take the helm, whilst others do not know the sea, ‘til they are drowned.
Comic/Page19-1_Bubble_4: I know for whom you search.
Comic/Page19-1_Bubble_6: Do you know where he is?
Comic/Page19-2_Bubble_3: Chemach has better uses for your flesh.
Comic/Page19-2_Bubble_9: Chemach finds things and makes them…
Comic/Page20-1_Bubble_1: The Cards will show as they see fit.
Comic/Page20-2_Bubble_2: Oh, they were so lost before Chemach found them...
Comic/Page21-1_Bubble_1: Of Godly wisdom, by Godly hand,
Comic/Page21-1_Bubble_2: these Cards were, will be, are bestowed.
Comic/Page21-1_Bubble_3: In the shaping of all things did the First distill all there was, will be known into mortal symbol for mortal understanding.
Comic/Page21-1_Bubble_4: Everlasting is my duty, keeper of these gifts, to stand at the juncture of fate and chance,
Comic/Page21-1_Bubble_5: for in the final breath of the final First it was decreed that we shall endure ‘til the sun’s final setting,
Comic/Page21-1_Bubble_6: when the Cards show only darkness for eternity and beyond.
Comic/Page21-2_Bubble_1: Things get lost and almost forgot…
Comic/Page21-2_Bubble_2: but Chemach knows that power lies somewhere deep within.
Comic/Page21-2_Bubble_3: Chemach will find it, will pull it out, why not?
Comic/Page25_Bubble_1: What is wrong with this place!?
Comic/Page25_Bubble_10: He said we’d be safe. But I’ve almost died twice
Comic/Page25_Bubble_11: and I don’t even know where he is!
Comic/Page25_Bubble_2: Monsters, and sacrifices, and creepy bird… duck… things!
Comic/Page25_Bubble_3: And what’s with all the cults?
Comic/Page25_Bubble_6: There’s lots of other stuff that could kill you.
Comic/Page25_Bubble_7: So why would he want me to come here?
Comic/Page26_Bubble_4: The Lands of the Old Faith are a big place!
Comic/Page27_Bubble_1: But what if we get caught by…
Comic/Page27_Bubble_10: I thought you knew this place like the back of your paw?
Comic/Page27_Bubble_3: Then we run! It’s nothing we can’t handle.
Comic/Page27_Bubble_4: Your brother wanted you to come here for a reason
Comic/Page27_Bubble_5: Don’t you want to find out why?
Comic/Page30-1_Bubble_1: Oh, I might be able to help you…
Comic/Page33_Bubble_5: so there must be some place we haven’t checked!
Comic/Page36_Bubble_4: ...cower as you are born to do.
Comic/Page37_Bubble_2: The great Shamura will drink deep your blood and tear flesh from bone.
Comic/Page37_Bubble_3: They will relieve you of your meaningless existence.
Comic/Page37_Bubble_4: You were born damned and you will die damned.
Comic/Page45_Bubble_2: It’s good to see you too, Jalala!
Comic/Page45_Bubble_4: This is what I wanted to show you!
Comic/Page48_Bubble_4: That is the Lamb, our saviour, our guide, our leader by divine right!
Comic/Page49_Bubble_11: You’re going to love it here!
Comic/Page49_Bubble_3: When you didn’t show up, I asked them to go looking for you.
Comic/Page4_2: ...come and see… Pilgrim’s… new home… safe…
Comic/Page4_Bubble_4: I saw you come out of the water.
Comic/Page50_Bubble_2: Actually, my name is Stinky now.
Comic/Page50_Bubble_4: I have a new name too!
Comic/Page5_Bubble_1: Are you here on a pilgrimage?
Comic/Page5_Bubble_11: I know all about this place!
Comic/Page5_Bubble_3: Then why did you come to the Lands of the Old Faith?
Comic/Page6_Bubble_4: How am I meant to find it now…?
Comic/Page7_Bubble_11: I heard that deep in the Lands lies a hidden paradise that only the chosen can find.
Comic/Page7_Bubble_12: Not even the Bishops know where it is.
Comic/Page7_Bubble_4: I know the Lands like the back of my paw.
Comic/Page7_Bubble_5: And I’m going on my pilgrimage, anyway.
Comic/Page8_Bubble_1: Wow, you don’t know anything, do you?
Comic/Page8_Bubble_2: Okay, so there’s these four Bishops…
Comic/Page8_Bubble_5: A Cult of the Lamb story
Comic/Page9_Bubble_1: …from my friend, who heard about it from their friend, who heard about it from some old owl guy,
Comic/Page9_Bubble_2: so I’m pretty sure it’s around here somewhere...
Comic/Page9_Bubble_3: Are you sure it’s safe out here, Rinor?
Comic/Page9_Bubble_6: Except for maybe the monsters. And the crazy Cultists. And the Bishops. And…
Comic/ThankYou: Thank you for journeying through the Lands of the Old Faith in Pilgrim!

Credits/KnightsOfUnity/Title: On behalf of The Knights of Unity:
Credits/NarayanaDedication: Dedicated in loving memory of Narayana Johnson (River Boy)
Credits/Thanks: Thank you for playing, noble disciple. Please spread the good word near and far so that others may be blessed by the divine teachings of the mighty Lamb.
DeathCat/BeatBoss1/0: Leshy fell before you like a grain of sand before a tidal wave.
DeathCat/BeatBoss1/2: I knew I chose wisely when I saved you. You have done well.
DeathCat/BeatBoss1/3: Continue your ruthless pursuit of the heretics, destroy all in your path and show <shake>no mercy.</shake>
DeathCat/BeatBoss1/_REMOVE_2: <color=yellow>Heket</color> will be the next of the Bishops for you to face. You will find her in <color=yellow>Anura.</color>
DeathCat/BeatBoss1/_REMOVE_3: Return to the Cult. I shall open your way to <color=yellow>Anura.</color>
DeathCat/BeatBoss2/0: I enjoyed watching you destroy Heket. Her arrogance was always destined to be her undoing.
DeathCat/BeatBoss2/1: Your merciless crusade against the <color=#FFD201>Old Faith</color> warms my cold, unbeating heart.
DeathCat/BeatBoss2/_REMOVE_1: The remaining Bishops will be growing wary of you now. Tread carefully.
DeathCat/BeatBoss2/_REMOVE_2: Upon your return to the Cult, I shall open the next door so you may continue your journey.
DeathCat/BeatBoss3/0: Kallamar was always a coward. This land is a better place now his pathetic, snivelling carcass is nothing more than a mound of rotting flesh.
DeathCat/BeatBoss3/1: Soon I shall be freed, and the world remade in my image.
DeathCat/BeatBoss3/2: All will pledge themselves to the Cult. All will bow to my name.
DeathCat/BeatBoss3/_REMOVE_1: Only Shamura remains. When you are ready, you know what must be done.
DeathCat/BeatBoss4/0: Shamura was weak, not wise. Their vision was too small to contain the multitudes of one such as I.
DeathCat/BossFinal/0: The time has come to free me. You shall have the honour of returning the Red Crown to its true bearer.
DeathCat/BossFinal/1: I admit, you have worn it almost as well as I could have myself.
DeathCat/BossFinal/2: You allowed {0} Followers to starve to death, because you knew they were barely worth the food they were fed.
DeathCat/BossFinal/3: You sacrificed {0} Followers to strengthen the Cult - to strengthen <shake>us.</shake>
DeathCat/BossFinal/4: You murdered {0} Followers in cold blood. I believe you enjoyed it.
DeathCat/BossFinal/5: Your appetite for death is something I can admire, Vessel. But the Crown is mine, and none - <shake>NONE</shake> - are worthy. None other than I.
DeathCat/BossFinal/6: You shall lay down your life and return to me what is mine. After millenia, all may bask in my glory once more.
DeathCat/BossFinal/7: But it cannot be done here. The final gate awaits. Hurry now, the time is at hand.
DeathCat/GenericDied0/0: Fear not, for you are my chosen vessel and death cannot halt you.
DeathCat/GenericDied0/1: I shall not allow it, for I still have need of you.
DeathCat/GenericDied0/2: Take what you have gathered. Build and strengthen the Cult. This is how power is gained.
DeathCat/GenericDied0/3: Continue on, undaunted. Each time you are brought down, you rise again stronger.
DeathCat/GenericDied1/0: Death is of little consequence. Rise once more, vessel of mine.
DeathCat/GenericDied1/1: It matters not how many times you are struck down. The Cult shall continue to grow.
DeathCat/Ratau/0: So, you fed Ratau to the wolves. Your treacherous opportunism has far exceeded my expectations.
DeathCat/Ratau/1: Ratau was an adequate servant, yet lacked the ruthlessness you have so eloquently displayed.
DeathCat/Ratau/2: He renounced his position after striking a bargain that resulted in the sacrifice of a Follower. He was weak, and allowed my Temple to descend into ruin. I see that is not a problem you share.
DeathCat/Ratau/3: I sent Ratau to aid you, but this pleases me greatly. A great Vessel takes their master’s will as their own. Very well done.
DeathCat/Story0/0: Very good, my vessel. It seems I chose well when I kept you from Death.
DeathCat/Story0/1: I will be watching your every move.
DeathCat/Story1/0: Do not make the mistake of becoming the servant of your Followers. They are for you to use to <shake>your advantage! </shake>
DeathCat/Story1/1: Their faith is a resource, spend it as you would gold. For you can always regain their trust with a well placed gesture of kindness.
DeathCat/Story1/2: Let it empower you, let it give you license to do unspeakable things. <wave>Bend them to your will. </wave>
DeathCat/Story1/3: I grant you the power to read their <wave>feeble little minds.</wave>
DeathCat/Story1_OLD/3: That is the power I have granted you, that is your <shake>right</shake> as Leader.
DeathCat/Story2/0: You see me here in chains, reduced to nothing. But it has not always been thus.
DeathCat/Story2/1: I was bound to this wretched place by the <color=#FFD201>Bishops of the Old Faith.</color> They betrayed me and left me to rot.
DeathCat/Story2/2: Each of the four chains that bind me are guarded by one of the <shake><color=#FFD201>Bishops.</color></shake>
DeathCat/Story2/3: Destroy the <color=#FFD201>Bishop</color> and you break the chain. Break all four and I will be freed.
DeathCat/Story2/4: I gave you life anew, vessel, and now you must repay the debt. You know what must be done.
DeathCat/Story2/5: To defeat the bishops you will need to become stronger. Sacrifice a follower to absorb more power - this will aid you in your quest to free me.
DeathCat/Story2/_delete0: Vessel, you have shown yourself worthy. You are ready to hear of your purpose.
DeathCat/Story2_OLD/6: You know what must be done.
DeathCat/Story3/0: Vessel, do you not worship me? Do you not give offerings in hopes of gaining my favor?
DeathCat/Story3/1: When you return to your Cult you shall find a new <color=#FFD201>Offering Chest.</color> There you can provide offerings that I, in my generosity, shall turn to gold, so that you might strengthen the Cult.
DeathCat/Story3/2: But I am not easily satisfied. The same gift offered too frequently will cause the price to be lowered. Yet fear not - over time, it will grow in value once more.
DeathCat/Story3/3: Give me proper tribute and you shall be rewarded.

Unlocks the <color=#FFD201>Natural Burial</color> building. The corpses of dead Followers may return to the earth by becoming fertiliser <sprite name=icon_Poop>
DoctrineUpgradeSystem/DeathSacrifice_Fun: Perform a <color=#FFD201>Ritual</color> at your temple to conduct a funeral for a recently passed Follower. Gain 20 Faith.
DoctrineUpgradeSystem/DeathSacrifice_Res: Perform a <color=#FFD201>Ritual</color> at your temple that allows you to bring a dead Follower back to life.
Perform a <color=#FFD201>Ritual</color> at your temple that allows you to bring a dead Follower back to life.
DoctrineUpgradeSystem/DeathSacrifice_Tra:
All Cult members will gain the Belief in Afterlife Trait.
Only lose -5 Faith when a Follower dies instead of -20.

All Cult members will gain the Good Die Young Trait.
Gain 10 Faith if an elder is sacrificed, murdered or consumed, but lose 20 Faith if an elder dies naturally.

All Cult members will gain the Respect Your Elders Trait.
Followers receive +5 Faith for every elderly Follower in the Cult.

All Cult members will gain the Belief in Sacrifice Trait.
+20 Faith when another Cult member is sacrificed.
DoctrineUpgradeSystem/Food/Description: Instruct them on the liturgies surrounding their daily bread.
DoctrineUpgradeSystem/Food2: Food of the predator, or food of the prey?
DoctrineUpgradeSystem/Food3: Bounty of the land, or of the sea?
DoctrineUpgradeSystem/Food4: Enlightenment through discipline, or the release of inhibition?

DoctrineUpgradeSystem/LawAndOrder2: Is all fair in love and war?
DoctrineUpgradeSystem/LawAndOrder4: Faith through devotion, or faith through donation?

Interact with a Follower to appoint them as your <color=#FFD201>Loyalty Enforcer,</color> tasked with patrolling the Cult and raising the <color=#FFD201>Loyalty</color> of your Followers.
DoctrineUpgradeSystem/LawOrder_AssignTax: Perform a <color=#FFD201>Ritual</color> at your temple in which you appoint a Follower as your <color=#FFD201>Tax Enforcer,</color> tasked with collecting <sprite name="icon_blackgold"> from other Cult members.
Interact with a Follower to appoint them as your <color=#FFD201>Tax Enforcer,</color> tasked with collecting <sprite name="icon_blackgold"> from other Cult members.
DoctrineUpgradeSystem/LawOrder_FightPitR: Perform a <color=#FFD201>Ritual</color> at your temple in which two Followers fight to the death - unless you're feeling merciful...
DoctrineUpgradeSystem/LawOrder_Judgement: Perform a <color=#FFD201>Ritual</color> at your temple so you can marry one of your Followers. Gain 30 Faith.
DoctrineUpgradeSystem/LawOrder_MurderFol:
Unlocks the Murder Follower Action.
A simple solution to many problems, but some Followers may find this upsetting... if they're awake to witness it.
DoctrineUpgradeSystem/LawOrder_TraitDisc: <sprite name="icon_FaithUp"> All are born guilty. Reduced faith loss when putting a follower in jail who is not dissenting.
DoctrineUpgradeSystem/LawOrder_TraitLibe: <sprite name="icon_FaithUp"> Freedom above all else. Every day that begins without anyone in prison, gain +10 Faith.

Brave Leader, I’m frightened of the dark… would you be able to bring me 10 <color=#FFD201>Charged Shards</color>?
You are so kind and generous! Praise the Lamb!
Leader, I was hoping you could bring me some <color=#FFD201>Rotburn</color> from The Rot? 10 will do! Just for… reasons!
You truly are magnificent, Leader! I wonder if it will <color=#FFD201>rot</color> me too…
Excuse me, Leader! I would love some mushrooms from <color=#FFD201>Anura...</color> Just to look at, I swear!
Leader, could you collect some spider silk from <color=#FFD201>Silk Cradle</color> for me?

Great Leader, there are rumours going around that we don't have enough food. Please prove us wrong by making some meals!

You have restored our faith in you, praise be the Lamb!

Did you see my moves? I'm the best dancer here!

Oh hello... <size=18>hiccup</size>... Lamb! Can I have a <color=#FFD201>Hearty Meat Broth?</color> I'm sooo hungry!
Benevolent Leader, please don't judge me, but... I've always wanted to eat a meal made of poop! Will you help me satisfy this dark desire?

Excuse me leader, my friend and I were traveling together through <color=#FFD201>Anura</color> and lost each other. Can you please see if you can find them?
Help Leader! Before you brought me into your Cult my sister and I were separated when travelling through <color=#FFD201>Anchordeep.</color> Please, can you go and find them?
Please Leader! My best friend is lost in <color=#FFD201>Silk Cradle,</color> can you go and save them? I would be so grateful!

…I bet you can though! So why don’t you give it a try?

Would you permit me to visit the <color=#FFD201>Mating Tent</color>?

<color=#FFD201>{0}</color> is... worthless. Do this world a favour... and <color=#FFD201>murder</color> them.

Yes… yes! It feasts on our flesh! It is feral! Be free and wild!
I was thinking about those animals in the <color=#FFD201>Ranch</color> and… wouldn’t it be funny to feed one of them <color=#FFD201>poop</color>?
Haha, that was so funny! What silly animals! Here’s an idea… what if you fed the same animal <color=#FFD201>more poop</color>?
The <color=#FFD201>Follower meat</color> makes it happy... how about feeding it one more time?
It ate the poop again! Come on Leader, one more time? Feed it a little more <color=#FFD201>poop</color>, everyone will laugh!
Now that is one stinky animal! You should take it for a walk so everyone can enjoy how stinky it is!
This is why you are such a great Leader!
FollowerInteractions/GiveQuest/OpenPub: Oh, great Leader... do you think the <color=#FFD201>Drinkhouse</color> will be open soon?
FollowerInteractions/GiveQuest/OpenPub/C: Thank you, wonderful Lamb! Time for a drink.
FollowerInteractions/GiveQuest/PerformRi: Can I tell you a lil' secret? Come closer… closer… <shake>I hate <color=#FFD201>{0}</color> and want them to die...</shake>
My head hurts... hey, have you seen <color=#FFD201>{0}</color> around? They're my best friend!
Leader, you know what would be just CRAZY? If we got married! Haha! Unless... wanna?
Wow! Was that a Wedding? Who got married?
Leader, we’ve had a wonderful marriage but… I’m not happy anymore! I want to <color=#FFD201>unmarry</color> you!
Please Leader, we have given you everything we own and we are all so poor now. Grant us some of your wealth. Let us share in your Gold.
Listen Leader, I'll cut to the chase: I want to be the <color=#FFD201>Loyalty Enforcer.</color> Let me prove that I am the right person for the job!
You must not let your Follower's loyalty lapse! Appoint me your <color=#FFD201>Loyalty Enforcer!</color>
I will do whatever is necessary to guard your reputation. Hehehe...
Please Leader, I wish I to be more use to you! I have so much more to offer... say, why don't you let me enforce the tax collection at this Cult?
This Cult needs more funds! Assign me as your <color=#FFD201>Tax Enforcer</color> and I will be thorough.
Do not fear, Lamb. I'll get exactly what you need.
Glorious Leader, we wish you to take us on a spiritual journey. Bend our conceptions of space and time with those mystical <wave><color=#FFD201>Menticide Mushrooms.</color></wave>
Your Followers... they bore me. A little <color=#FFD201>Brainwashing Ritual</color> should liven things up.
Hehehe, woo!
Leader I hunger to feast on Follower flesh... I think everyone agrees. How about a <color=#FFD201>Gluttony of Cannibals Ritual?</color>
Mmm, delicious! Thank you very much.
Glorious Leader, I want to become one with you! Please, consume me.
Leader… I want more… more <color=#FFD201>Rotten</color>...
Would you… the <color=#FFD201>Ritual of Decay</color>... make a new Rotten… please?
Yes… more Rotten…
Darling Lamb, this isn’t easy for me to say, but… I’ve fallen in love with someone else!
I think we should end our relationship with the <color=#FFD201>Divorce</color> ritual. No, don’t cry!
Thank you for understanding, Lamb.
Thank you, Lamb. I wish you every happiness!
Many of us have managed to save some spare coin. To show our gratitude we wish to donate it to you and the Cult!
Wonderful Leader, times have been tough... a <color=#FFD201>Festival of Libation</color> seems deserved!
The days are dragging and blurring together. We need inspiration! Please, <wave>enlighten</wave> us!
Leader, it's getting too relaxed around here. We need to encourage the others to develop spiritual strength, and learn to resist temptation. Let us be tested with a Fast!
Lamb, hunger... desperation... discipline... these are your tools. A <color=#FFD201> Ritual Fast</color> is due.
Reward. Deprive. You are... their God...
The talk amongst the Cult is that our settlement is too small. To celebrate your glory we must build, build, build!
Leader, all of us loyal Followers would love to get together and have a splendid dinner! Do you think you could throw us a feast?
Lamb... I want... a <color=#FFD201>feast</color>...
Delicious.
Great Leader, <color=#FFD201>{0}</color> insulted me and I demand satisfaction! I wish to face them in the <color=#FFD201>Fight Pit! </color>
Lifetimes ago... I was a warrior... allow me to relive my glory in the <color=#FFD201>Fight Pit.</color>
Head high! Back straight! Yield, foe!
We have been talking and we are tired of the food here. We need some variety. Please, would you make us some fish dishes?
Bring forth... the <color=#FFD201>Ritual of the Ocean's Bounty</color>.
Good... I felt like fish.
Leader, <color=#FFD201>{1}</color> and I are in love! Will you allow us to be <color=#FFD201>married</color>?
You are a loving and generous Leader. We love you!
Glorious Leader, we are all grieving <color=#FFD201>{0}</color>. It would help if we could give them the proper send off they deserve.
Great Leader, there are rumours that you can command the crops to grow. Is this true? We wish to see it!
Bring forth... the <color=#FFD201>Ritual of the Harvest</color>.
Good. I was getting... hungry.
We are all exhausted, please let us have a break. We wish to observe the sabbath.
Lamb, you overstep! I deserve - er, we deserve - a <color=#FFD201>Holy Day!</color>
Yes, yes, well done. Now get out of my sun! I'm relaxing.
Ranch animals make strange things… you should perform the <color=#FFD201>Ritual of Shearing</color> so we get more!
You are so wise, Leader!
These winters are so harsh. I’m starving! Perform the <color=#FFD201>Ritual of Gorging</color> so we can have delicious meat…
Excellent. Delicious!
Glorious Leader, everyone misses <color=#FFD201>{0}</color> dearly, is there a way to bring them back? ...any way at all?
Death is your plaything. Resurrect <color=#FFD201>{0}</color> and demonstrate your mastery.
Haha! Gets me every time.
Great Leader, I have already given everything I own to you, now I wish to also give my life. Please, sacrifice me in your glorious name.
Ah, the thrill of a sacrifice... sacrifice <color=#FFD201>{0}</color> so that I might relive it.
To snuff the flame of life... glorious.
War demands sacrifice. Wisdom is knowing which sacrifice to make. Make a sacrifice, Lamb.
Hm? I asked you to..? I cannot recall.
You’ve made some good <color=#FFD201>Snowlambs</color>! What if you performed the <color=#FFD201>Life to the Ice</color> Ritual and brought them to life?
Look at them go! So magical… thank you, Leader!
Great leader, I... like you... No! I <wave>love you!</wave> Would you make me the happiest creature in the world and marry me?
Through fear or love may Gods rule. Morale must be maintained in the ranks. A <color=#FFD201>wedding</color>, Lamb?
<wave>Celebration in battle, strength in fear, light in dark, keep them near.</wave>
Great Leader, we are exhilarated by your teachings, we adore you and we are ready to commit ourselves to you and work to the glory of the Cult!
Lamb, you allow your Followers too much luxury. They must know <color=#FFD201>Glory Through Toil!</color>
Watch them slave away for you... that is leadership. Wait. Must I work too?
FollowerInteractions/GiveQuest/PlaceStru: Glorious Leader, the base is an eye sore, we need beauty to celebrate your glory! Let us build <color=#FFD201>decorations</color> in your honour.
FollowerInteractions/GiveQuest/RecruitCu: Please Leader, there are some folks who are starving and have no place to call home, we must let them join our Cult!
Leader! Sceptics and heretics have made their way to our Cult, cursing our way of life... but they want to join! Should we welcome them?
Excuse me leader! Some poor freezing creatures have come here seeking shelter. Should we let them in?
Excuse me Leader, some creatures are here seeking shelter with our Cult, but they are sick! Should we let them join?
Glorious Leader! Some elders have been cast from their Cult and now seek a place to enjoy their final years. Maybe we should let them join ours?
FollowerInteractions/GiveQuest/Ritual_Bo: Excuse me, Lamb. I had a dream last night of dancing around a great fire. It seemed so familiar…
I would love to dance again. Would you mind performing the <color=#FFD201>Bonfire Ritual II</color>?
Thank you. It reminded me of… something…
FollowerInteractions/GiveQuest/SendFollo: Glorious Leader, let us preach your word far and wide! <color=#FFD201>{0}</color> has said they are willing to go on a Mission - let them go!
Lamb, I have been thinking... it's time for me to go on a <color=#FFD201>Missionary</color>!
Glorious Leader, we caught <color=#FFD201>{0}</color> stealing from another cult member. We demand justice, please leader, imprison them!
FollowerInteractions/GiveQuest/SendSpous: Lamb… my spouse <color=#FFD201>{0}</color> is driving me crazy! I need space. Will you send them away on a <color=#FFD201>Missionary</color> please?
Thank you, Leader! I’ll see them if they return - I mean when they return!
FollowerInteractions/GiveQuest/Story_10_: I hope to be worthy of your trust. Now that I’m a Disciple, don’t you think I should dress… better?
I want to look posh. A Genteel Jacket will be perfect!
Oh my, who’s that good-looking creature…?
Oh wondrous Lamb, everyday I wake and dedicate myself to you, and go to sleep thinking of you.
Don’t you think that your best Disciple deserves the best place to sleep? A Grand Shelter, maybe?
Perfect! This will really let me dedicate myself to you more. <wave>Yaaaaawn.</wave>
Magnificent Lamb, I want to make a toast in your honour!
But to make a toast, I'd need some Grape Nectar, right?
A toast to the Leader! <wave>PRAISE THE LAMB.</wave>
Lamb, I am starving after being such a dedicated Disciple.
I could go for something light… how about a Mighty Meat Feast?
Mmm, delicious! Now I’m all fuelled up and ready to pray some more.
Lamb, don’t you want to make more great Disciples? Not through a Ritual, I mean…
Don’t you think that a Disciple could make the best Follower… in the Mating Tent?
Don’t worry, Leader. We made a GREAT Follower in there.
FollowerInteractions/GiveQuest/Story_11_: Oh mighty Lamb, I have proven myself as your Disciple, haven’t I?
If you think I am worthy of a reward, I have one request… a Wedding Dress! Please, it’s so elegant.
Leader, I thank you for my Wedding Dress. It was perfect… for a while.
But fashion moves forward! Now, I want nothing more than a Wedding Suit. That’s peak style!
Leader, my Wedding Suit was fantastic, but I have realised something…
There’s nothing so stylish as our natural forms. Yes - our NUDE forms. I request a Rite of Lust!
I am overcome… by the beauty…!
FollowerInteractions/GiveQuest/Story_12_: Leader, I love <color=#FFD201>{0}</color> more than anything else in the world - except for you, of course!
But will you allow <color=#FFD201>{0}</color> and I to marry?
Thank you, Leader! I will love <color=#FFD201>{0}</color> and only <color=#FFD201>{0}</color> for the rest of my life.
Wise Leader, I love being married to <color=#FFD201>{2}</color> of course, but…
Well, isn’t <color=#FFD201>{0}</color> lovely? Maybe we could spend some time in the <color=#FFD201>Mating Tent</color> together.
What <color=#FFD201>{2}</color> doesn’t know won’t hurt them!
Great Leader, you know me! I have a lot of love to give. And I’d like to give some to <color=#FFD201>{0}</color> in the <color=#FFD201>Mating Tent</color>.
That was the last time, I swear! Thank you, Leader.
Generous Leader, <color=#FFD201>{0}</color> and I get along so well. I think it’s <color=#FFD201>Mating Tent</color> time!
Our little secret, hm? Don’t tell <color=#FFD201>{2}</color>!
I can’t help it, they all love me! You understand, don’t you Leader?
Leader! <color=#FFD201>{0}</color> and I are married but they’re unfaithful!
That little…! They don’t deserve me! They don’t deserve to live in this paradise! They must be <color=#FFD201>murdered</color>!
Better than that scoundrel deserved. You’re the best, Leader.
FollowerInteractions/GiveQuest/Story_13_: Great Lamb, <color=#FFD201>{0}</color> is so beautiful… I want to impress them with my dancing in the <color=#FFD201>Drum Circle</color>!
Well? Was <color=#FFD201>{0}</color> watching? I really gave it my all!
Loving Lamb, it worked! <color=#FFD201>{0}</color> has agreed to marry me. Will you do the honours?
Leader, I’ve never been happier in my life!
FollowerInteractions/GiveQuest/Story_14_: Leader, <color=#FFD201>{0}</color> and I have been married a while… but I can’t help it, I’m in love with you! Will you get rid of them for me?
Good, I was sick of them!
Wonderful Leader, now that I am no longer married, we can be together! Will you marry me?
I promise to be yours forever! I am devoted to you, Lamb.
FollowerInteractions/GiveQuest/Story_1_0: Leader! I'm in love! But <color=#FFD201>{0}</color> doesn't know I exist… would you gather ten flowers for me from Darkwood so that I might woo them?
Thank you, Leader! Now I just need to work up the courage to talk to them…
FollowerInteractions/GiveQuest/Story_1_1: Leader, I gave <color=#FFD201>{0}</color> flowers but it’s not enough! I need to WOW them. Can you make a delicious meal for us to share?
Thank you, thank you! This will definitely win their heart.
FollowerInteractions/GiveQuest/Story_1_2: Leader, my heart is in pieces. My love loves another! <color=#FFD201>{0}</color> has taken them from me, and I demand satisfaction. I want to fight!
Great Leader, I was telling <color=#FFD201>{0}</color> how much you have done for us and they… they… they fell in love with you instead! I can’t compete with one such as you… will you marry them?
Although my heart is broken, I’m happy that the both of you are happy.
FollowerInteractions/GiveQuest/Story_2_0: Leader, my brother and I were traveling together through Darkwood and were separated. I never knew what became of him… do you think you could find out?
Oh Leader, I am so grateful! My brother is here at last!
FollowerInteractions/GiveQuest/Story_2_1: Leader, my brother <color=#FFD201>{0}</color> has joined us here and… and… I can’t stand him! Our whole lives he has overshadowed me, but no more. Let us fight!
I knew he would be no match for me!
Leader, thank you again for rescuing <color=#FFD201>{0}</color>! In fact, he is so grateful that he wishes to marry you. What do you say, great Lamb?
FollowerInteractions/GiveQuest/Story_2_2: Hey… Leader… I know that you’re married to <color=#FFD201>{0}</color> already but… I… I… I’m in love with you! Would you ever consider… I mean, would it be possible… will you marry me too?
This is the happiest day of my life!
FollowerInteractions/GiveQuest/Story_3_0: Leader! These new recruits have no work ethic. If you ask me, they should have to prove themselves. Make them work through the night!
FollowerInteractions/GiveQuest/Story_3_1: Leader, the new Followers around here have grown too used to a certain way of living. Strife creates character! I think simple meals for a while, don’t you?
Yes! One less temptation for the tempted.
FollowerInteractions/GiveQuest/Story_3_2: Leader, I was thinking… these newbies have worked hard, and proven themselves. Perhaps we should light the firepit and have a night off? Only if you think it wise, Leader!
FollowerInteractions/GiveQuest/Story_4_0: Pathetic Lamb. This is what your labors have wrought? This place holds not a single candle to the magnificence of my Temple, now gone.
FollowerInteractions/GiveQuest/Story_4_1: Leshy was a being of chaos. The beauty of his realm… I wonder if the flowers still grow without him.
I asked not for these! You think me a soft fool!? Damned Lamb…
FollowerInteractions/GiveQuest/Story_4_2: It is a testament to the strength of my Crown, that you should traverse <color=#FFD201>Anura</color> and emerge unscathed. Even after I cut her throat, Heket’s words were more toxic and foul than the mushrooms that grew in her domain.
Ha! Vile things, still they persist. As vile things are wont to do.
FollowerInteractions/GiveQuest/Story_4_3: Do you fear me, Lamb? My brother, <color=#FFD201>Kallamar</color>, lived in fear of me. He shook at the mere thought of death! In his temple he thought himself safe. How I wish to see those crystal walls crumbled!
So this is all that persists of <color=#FFD201>Kallamar’s</color> temple. It was a thing of beauty, once.
FollowerInteractions/GiveQuest/Story_4_4: …did <color=#FFD201>Shamura</color> weep when you fought? Once, their mind was gracious like spider’s silk. It reminds me of them…
FollowerInteractions/GiveQuest/Story_4_5: Lamb, you bear my Crown. You wield my power. And yet I cannot call you worthy. A Follower has perished from this world. What rites is such a pathetic creature afforded?
Hm. So you observe their passing from this world to the next as a ship to sea. Interesting.
Lamb, you bear my Crown. You wield my power. And yet I cannot call you worthy. A Follower has perished from this world. What rites is such a pathetic creature afforded?
Ha! Hahahaha! I cannot begrudge supplantation by one such as yourself. Why contain death? And with none to stand in your way. You are, after all, the last God left in the Lands of the Old Faith.
FollowerInteractions/GiveQuest/Story_4_6: Lamb. Mortal life is so… fragile. So fleeting. So long did I stand at the gates between this life and the next, trapped at the nexus of what was, and what wasn’t.
The lands of my siblings… what do they look like now? The sites of their demise…
Lamb. I wish to see this world, and what has become of it.
FollowerInteractions/GiveQuest/Story_5_0: Hmm, I dunno about all this… if you were a truly great Leader, wouldn’t this place look… nicer?
I guess that’s a bit better…
FollowerInteractions/GiveQuest/Story_5_1: If you really are a chosen one, then can’t you make the crops grow with magic or something?
If you really are a chosen one, then shouldn’t the fish be jumping into your net?
FollowerInteractions/GiveQuest/Story_5_2: Leader, I am ashamed to have ever doubted you. I am steeped in sin! The only thing left for me to offer is my life. It would be an honor to be sacrificed in your name.
Thank you for sacrificing them, I’m sure they are happy now!
FollowerInteractions/GiveQuest/Story_6_0: Psst! Leader! Rumour has it that <color=#FFD201>{0}</color> is a spy, sent by an enemy Cult to undermine your great power… you should go speak with them and see what they have to say for themselves.
Well obviously they're hiding something! You must believe me, Leader!
FollowerInteractions/GiveQuest/Story_6_1: Leader, <color=#FFD201>{0}</color> continues to masquerade as faithful… something must be done! You need to imprison them!
Thank you for keeping us safe, Leader.
FollowerInteractions/GiveQuest/Story_6_2: Leader, <color=#FFD201>{0}</color> will not give up their games… I fear you must take care of them. Permanently. Sacrifice them!
You have done what you must for the good of us all. They were a traitor!
FollowerInteractions/GiveQuest/Story_7_0: Leader, it would be so funny if we pulled some hilarious pranks on <color=#FFD201>{0}</color>. They are a real picky eater, so let's make them eat poop!
Haha oh Leader, you are so funny! We are so lucky to have such a leader with such a great sense of humour.
FollowerInteractions/GiveQuest/Story_7_1: Leader, that was hilarious! Let's do it again. I know <color=#FFD201>{0}</color> will find the funny side of it.
I can't believe they fell for it again! I couldn't stop laughing, how did they manage to finish the whole thing without realising?
FollowerInteractions/GiveQuest/Story_7_2: Leader, I have our next prank. We put <color=#FFD201>{0}</color> in prison! They will be terrified, it will be so funny.
They were so confused and scared - it was so funny! I'll have to think of how we can top that prank next time!
FollowerInteractions/GiveQuest/Story_7_3: OK, so it's time to take these pranks to the next level... let's murder <color=#FFD201>{0}</color>. It will be hilarious!
Haha I can't stop laughing, the look of terror in their eyes was hysterical! You are too funny! Pranking is the best.
FollowerInteractions/GiveQuest/Story_8_0: O great and generous Lamb! I have heard some sick followers from Sozo’s seeking refuge in your Cult. Their old Leader has always been capricious, but ever since he got his hands on all those mushrooms… please, Lamb! May they stay?
You are as wonderful as they say!
FollowerInteractions/GiveQuest/Story_8_1: Leader, I… I… I miss mushrooms! Will you perform the Brainwashing Ritual, please? I need <shake>mushrooms…</shake>
O mighty mushrooms… I mean Lamb…
FollowerInteractions/GiveQuest/Story_9_0: Wonderful Leader, I don’t know if I am worthy… but I want to be your Disciple!
Oh thank you, thank you! I won't let you down.
FollowerInteractions/GiveQuest/Story_9_1: I, your Disciple, wish to prove myself in blood. Throw me in the pit, honoured Lamb!
Wonderful Lamb, I still wish to prove my Discipleship.
Lock me in the stocks! I will prove myself through discipline! I will survive there for three days!
FollowerInteractions/GiveQuest/Story_9_2: I still haven’t proven myself enough. I will do anything for you. I will eat poop! Let me eat poop!
The poop… I ate the poop…!
FollowerInteractions/GiveQuest/Story_9_3: Blessed Lamb, I am your Disciple, your mouthpiece in this world. Send me to convert heretics, I beg!
I will spread your gospel like a true Disciple! Don’t worry about me, Leader!
FollowerInteractions/GiveQuest/TakeCults: <color=#FFD201>{0}</color> looks perfect today, I want to remember it forever. Can you take some kind of ever-lasting picture?
Amazing, Leader! We should treasure this picture always!
FollowerInteractions/GiveQuest/UseFirePi: Light the fires and let us dance deep into the night!
FollowerInteractions/GiveQuest/WinterDri: Mighty Lamb! It's so cold... a <color=#FFD201>Spiced Brew</color> from the <color=#FFD201>Drinkhouse</color> will warm me up nicely!
FollowerInteractions/GiveQuest/Woolhaven: I can see it so clearly. A beautiful haven, sparkling white in the winter and blooming in the spring.
Is this… real? How do I know it?
My lamb, you are a creator of miracles. This town, <color=#FFD201>full of flowers</color>... would you make it so?
You have… done it? Made this place of my dreams? Oh…

FollowerInteractions/PoemConvo_Disciple_:
How dark my world, O! How lost my soul,
'Til Lamb hath found and made me whole.

Fear once common, world once torn,
'Til the era of the Lamb did dawn.

The Lamb is love, the Lamb is light;
For the Lamb I fall, for the Lamb I fight.

On hallowed ground, I doth did tread,
To praise the Crown atop their head.

Holy beast, thy kingdom blessed,
The sun doth shine at Lamb's behest.

FollowerThoughts/MurderousSpouse_Killed_: Yes... YES... I am the one true spouse!
I am the only spouse worthy of the Leader!
FollowerThoughts/Narinder_1/Description: I suppose they are a competent Leader... and fluffy...
FollowerThoughts/Narinder_2/Description: To go where I please... move without burden... I'm glad.
FollowerThoughts/Narinder_3/Description: I have the sudden urge to run around.
FollowerThoughts/Narinder_4/Description: Years gone by... if things had been different...
FollowerThoughts/NaturallySkepticalTrait: I'm not sure this stuff has any scientific backing...
FollowerThoughts/NewEnemy/Description: May the great Leader smite them down!
FollowerThoughts/NewEnemy/Description/Bi: If only I could smite them like the old days!
FollowerThoughts/NewLover/Description: This is the one, I can feel it!
FollowerThoughts/NewOutfit_1/Description: Look at me, look at me, I'm the prettiest Follower here!
FollowerThoughts/NewOutfit_2/Description: The Leader picked such a nice outfit for me...
FollowerThoughts/NewOutfit_3/Description: Everybody is looking at me, I look so good!
FollowerThoughts/NewOutfit_4/Description: Mhmm, I'm so handsome in my handsome clothes.
FollowerThoughts/NewOutfit_5/Description: I am so grand and impressive in these clothes! Wow!
FollowerThoughts/NoLongerDissenting/Desc: Once doubtful, now I have seen the light.
FollowerThoughts/NoLongerFreezing_1/Desc: Ahhhh, that feels amazing... I'm so toasty!
FollowerThoughts/NoLongerStarving/Descri: I'm no longer starving, but I can't believe this happened!
FollowerThoughts/NoTemple/Description: What kind of Cult doesn't have a temple?
FollowerThoughts/NudismRitual_1/Descript: I've never felt so free! I love being nude!
FollowerThoughts/NudismRitual_2/Descript: There's nothing like feeling the breeze on your... stomach!
FollowerThoughts/NudismRitual_3/Descript: To be in our most natural state... it feels amazing.
FollowerThoughts/NudismRitual_4/Descript: I love to show the world all of me!
FollowerThoughts/OldAge/Description: I have lived a good life of service, but now I grow weary.
FollowerThoughts/OverwhelmedParent_0/Des: I need someone to hug me for a change!
FollowerThoughts/OverwhelmedParent_1/Des: I don't know how the Lamb can look after so many... I can barely look after one!
FollowerThoughts/OverwhelmedParent_2/Des: This is hard... who knew it was so hard?
FollowerThoughts/OverwhelmedParent_4/Des: This is such a blessing... definitely a blessing...
FollowerThoughts/Pacifist/Description: None of that here! Some of these Followers are animals, I swear.
FollowerThoughts/PlayedSnow_2/Descriptio: Hahaha! Time for a snowball fight!
FollowerThoughts/PrisonReEducation/Descr: I'm having my thoughts corrected, and learning the error of my ways.
FollowerThoughts/PropogandaSpeakers/Desc: I hear the Leader's message, I will work harder.
FollowerThoughts/PurgeRitualTerrified_1/: Is it over? That was the scariest day of my whole life!
FollowerThoughts/PurgeRitualTerrified_2/: How could the Leader let something that awful happen?
FollowerThoughts/PurgeRitual_1/Descripti: It's good to let off some steam every now and then!
FollowerThoughts/PurgeRitual_2/Descripti: The pain... the chaos... the violence... I've never felt so alive...
FollowerThoughts/PurgeRitual_3/Descripti: It's nice not to worry about rules and peace sometimes.
FollowerThoughts/RanchHarvest/Descriptio: What an abundance these animals provide!
FollowerThoughts/RanchMeat/Description: Yum! I'm in the mood for tasty meat!
FollowerThoughts/ReactChild_Negative_1/D: I'm worried that they're unhappy. I hope they don't leave when they grow up!
FollowerThoughts/ReactChild_Negative_2/D: My child is a bit... strange. They didn't get that from me!
FollowerThoughts/ReactChild_Negative_3/D: Ugh, they're so annoying. Leave me alone!
FollowerThoughts/ReactChild_Posititve_0/: Oh, what a sweet child! I'm so proud. They're going to be a great Follower.
FollowerThoughts/ReactChild_Posititve_1/: They're growing up so fast. How precious!
FollowerThoughts/ReactChild_Posititve_2/: I love my darling child. I know they're going to do the Leader proud.
FollowerThoughts/ReactChild_Posititve_3/: I remember when they were just an egg... how time flies!
FollowerThoughts/ReactDecoration/Descrip: How beautiful! Why would anyone want to leave such a paradise?
How beautiful! The Lamb is pretty good at decorating.
FollowerThoughts/ReactDecorationFalseIdo: Such beauty surrounds us... praise be to the Cult!
Such beauty surrounds us... praise be to the Cult!
FollowerThoughts/ReactGrave/Description: May my fellow Cult member rest in peace.
FollowerThoughts/ReactGraveAfterlife/Des: I wonder what awaits my fellow Follower in the afterlife?
FollowerThoughts/ReactGraveEnemy/Descrip: I never liked that Follower, I'm glad they're gone.
FollowerThoughts/ReactGraveLover/Descrip: I miss my lover so much! Thankfully, the leader gave them a proper grave.
FollowerThoughts/ReactToFullOuthouse/Des: Disgusting! How hard would it be to build another?
FollowerThoughts/ReactToFullOuthouseCopr: Such nauseating, putrid mess... I love it.
FollowerThoughts/ReactToPoop/Description: Gross! Someone should clean that up before someone gets ill.
FollowerThoughts/ReactToPoopCoprophiliac: I saw poop! What a great day.
FollowerThoughts/ReactToVomit/Descriptio: Gross! Someone needs to clean that up before someone gets ill.
FollowerThoughts/ReactToVomitCoprophilia: Is it wrong that I want to taste it?
FollowerThoughts/ReceivedGift/Descriptio: How blessed I am that the Leader chose to bestow a gift upon ME!
This is merely a trinket! It's nice though.
FollowerThoughts/ReceivedNecklace/Descri: I cannot believe our glorious Leader gave me such a beautiful gift!
It does look good on me, I admit.
FollowerThoughts/RemoveRot/Description: The great Lamb cures all! What a virtuous Leader.
FollowerThoughts/ResentfulConvert/Descri: You converted me by force, I had no choice.
FollowerThoughts/ResentfulRescued/Descri: I would have been just fine if you hadn't shown up.
FollowerThoughts/RitualMidwinter_1/Descr: How nice to be together! And I got a great gift.
FollowerThoughts/RitualWarmth/Descriptio: So beautiful... what a wonderful world...
FollowerThoughts/SacrificedOldFollower/D: Our glorious Leader sacrificed an elder! Probably for the best...
FollowerThoughts/SadFromDungeonNPC/Descr: I was trying to do my tasks, next thing I knew I was in a dungeon! Horrible!
FollowerThoughts/SawIcegor_1/Description: Oh my Lamb, what is that!?
FollowerThoughts/SawYouButcheringDeadFol: I know our Leader has their reasons, but still...
Saw you Butchering Dead Follower<sprite name="icon_Trait_Cannibal">
FollowerThoughts/Shamura_0/Description: Hm, what was... and then... oh, I've forgotten...
FollowerThoughts/Shamura_1/Description: Yes, we must... there is no other way...
FollowerThoughts/Shamura_3/Description: Where are my siblings? Weren't they just... we were just...
FollowerThoughts/Shamura_4/Description: Silk laden kingdom, room of war, where are my scrolls...?
FollowerThoughts/SkepticalConvert/Descri: I've converted, but not convinced. Let's see how things go...
FollowerThoughts/SleepInterrupted/Descri: I was rudely awoken during the night.
FollowerThoughts/SleptHouse1/Description: At least I wasn't out in the cold, but I'd prefer a house.
FollowerThoughts/SleptHouse1Materialisti: Sleeping in a bag? Unacceptable. I require luxury!
FollowerThoughts/SleptHouse2/Description: I had a decent night's sleep.
FollowerThoughts/SleptHouse2Materialisti: Getting better, but still not good enough!
FollowerThoughts/SleptHouse3/Description: I slept like a baby. I love my house.
FollowerThoughts/SleptHouse3Materialisti: Finally I have a dwelling suitable for my splendour.
FollowerThoughts/SleptOutisde/Descriptio: I need you to build me somewhere to sleep.
FollowerThoughts/SleptOutisdeMaterialist: Me, sleeping outside like a common hobo?! Unthinkable!
FollowerThoughts/SleptThroughYouButcheri: Slept Through You Butchering Dead Follower
I thought I heard something in the night, and when I woke up the body was gone...
FollowerThoughts/SomeoneDissenterZealotT: Lock up the heretics! Show no mercy!
FollowerThoughts/SomeoneIllGermophobe/De: Disgusting! They better not sneeze on me.
FollowerThoughts/Sozo_AteMushroomo_0/Des: Yes, yes... Mushroomo wants to be eaten, yes Sozo?
FollowerThoughts/Sozo_AteMushroomo_1/Des: They deserve to be eaten... I hate Mushroomo...
FollowerThoughts/Sozo_AteMushroomo_2/Des: Cry, cry all you want! Sozo will get you...
FollowerThoughts/Sozo_AteMushroomo_3/Des: Sozo wants... Sozo will do anything... Mushroomo...
FollowerThoughts/Sozo_AteMushroomo_4/Des: Hehehe... they do not care about Sozo... no one cares about Sozo...
FollowerThoughts/Sozo_Dissenter_0/Descri: How... how dare...! Sozo will get revenge...!
FollowerThoughts/Sozo_Dissenter_1/Descri: No! No! Sozo needs mushroom! No! I must...!
FollowerThoughts/Sozo_Dissenter_2/Descri: Ahh... Sozo shakes, Sozo aches, Sozo is hurt... need... need...
FollowerThoughts/Sozo_Dissenter_3/Descri: Give me mushroom! Give me mushroom! GIVE ME MUSHROOM!
FollowerThoughts/Sozo_Dissenter_4/Descri: Where are mushrooms!? Where are they!? I need them! I need them...
FollowerThoughts/Sozo_EatMushroom_1/Desc: What's that? I can hear... things... whisper about Sozo...
FollowerThoughts/Sozo_EatMushroom_2/Desc: Mushrooms, mushrooms, mushrooms, mushrooms, mushrooms, mushrooms...
FollowerThoughts/Sozo_EatMushroom_3/Desc: Need... Sozo needs... where are... Mimi...?
FollowerThoughts/Sozo_Revived/Descriptio: Mushrooms here... mushrooms there... so many mushrooms, I am drowning! Ha... ha...
FollowerThoughts/SpouseKiss/Description: What a beautiful moment, our great Leader is so loving.
FollowerThoughts/SpouseKiss/Description/: That was nice. Maybe the Lamb will smooch me again...
FollowerThoughts/Spy_0/Description: Don't be suspicious, don't be suspicious, don't be suspicious...
FollowerThoughts/Spy_1/Description: Hehe just a few more days and I'll grab the Coins and go!
FollowerThoughts/Spy_2/Description: I'll get away with this for sure! The Lamb can't actually read minds.
FollowerThoughts/Spy_3/Description: I'm glad I wasn't indoctrinated. That would be embarrassing!
FollowerThoughts/Spy_4/Description: They'll never catch me! I'm the best spy in the world!
FollowerThoughts/StrangerDied/Descriptio: I'm sad a fellow Cult member has died. May their spirit live on.
FollowerThoughts/TiredFromMissionary/Des: Things are different out there... are we really doing the right thing?
FollowerThoughts/TiredFromMissionaryHapp: Seeing the rest of the world has reminded me how lucky I am to be in this Cult.
It was good to see the world again! But it's good to be back, too.
FollowerThoughts/TiredFromMissionaryScar: The outside world is terrifying! I never want to leave again!
FollowerThoughts/UpsetNoSermonYesterday/: The Leader didn't preach yesterday. Have we been forsaken?
What a lazy Leader! No Sermon? Unbelievable.
FollowerThoughts/UsedHotspring/Descripti: What absolute bliss... someone bring me a drink!
FollowerThoughts/WatchedSermon/Descripti: An inspiring sermon from our glorious Leader.
FollowerThoughts/WatchedSermonDevotee/De: It was magnificent to see our Leader preaching!
A magnificent Sermon! They are a good Leader, after all.
FollowerThoughts/WatchedSermonSameAsYest: That was the same sermon as yesterday. Boring!
FollowerThoughts/WinterEnded_1/Descripti: The sun! The sky! Let's frolic!
FollowerThoughts/WinterEnded_2/Descripti: Ahh, I'm so glad that winter is over.
FollowerThoughts/WinterInspired_1/Descri: The cold wind... the sparkling snow... the ice... it's art!
FollowerThoughts/WinterInspired_2/Descri: There is nothing so moving as a world snowed under.
FollowerThoughts/WinterStarted_1/Descrip: The cold returns... somebody hold me!
FollowerThoughts/Wolves/Description: Ahhhh! What big ears! What big noses! What big teeth!
FollowerThoughts/WorkThroughNight/Descri: I will prove my virtue! I will work all day and all night.
FollowerThoughts/Yngya_1/Description: How beautiful and fresh... why do I love it so...?
FollowerThoughts/Yngya_2/Description: Ah, the howl of winter! The power and purity. Such force...
FollowerThoughts/Yngya_3/Description: It's much too warm... much too bright... my heart aches...
FollowerThoughts/Zombie_3/Description: Saw... light... brought... back... who... me?

Inventory/Necklace_4/Lore: Beauty is in the eye of the bearer.

Inventory/Necklace_Gold_Skull/Lore: Cast in gold, time shall not touch ye.

Inventory/Necklace_Loyalty/Lore: Blind faith is still yet true.

Lore/Lore_0/Description: Writings from a time long passed.
Lore/Lore_0/Lore: I meant only to survive, and yet she, feathered hand of Great Ones gone, has seen me to be worthy. Oh, First Gods, guide me! I devote myself to you, wholly, body and soul. I will strike down dissent. I will cull doubt. I will nourish this Crown and be worthy of this power. In blood, I swear.
Lore/Lore_1/Description: Writings from a time long passed.
Lore/Lore_1/Lore: Great Ones, I find fragments of your power across these vast lands. The blades once gripped by your mighty fists, the tears once fallen from your all-seeing eyes, the ichor that runs through the very veins of the earth… I seek your understanding. I prostrate myself before you. I vow that those who will not serve in their life will serve with their death instead.
Lore/Lore_10/Description: A torn letter, stained with blood.
Lore/Lore_10/Lore: Found a herd. Taken care of. Let the Worm know I seek the next.
Lore/Lore_11/Description: A torn letter, stained with blood.
Lore/Lore_11/Lore: One fled my blade. I will find it. The Bishops need not concern themselves. I do as I am told, and only as I am told.
Lore/Lore_12/Description: A torn letter, stained with blood.
Lore/Lore_12/Lore: I found the last, hidden deep in the Lands. It followed me, silent, to the ritual grounds. When my task is at last complete, I will bury it with the others.
Lore/Lore_13/Lore: Great Hunter, we write this prayer and leave this offering in the hopes you will grant us triumph in our hunt. We vow to take no more than we need, and leave the brooding and the young. May we be swift and silent as you, Hunter.
Lore/Lore_14/Description: Written in fear, covered in dirt.
Lore/Lore_14/Lore: We’ve been hiding for days. I’m hungry, but I’m too scared to leave this place, though the earth no longer shakes. I didn’t know the Bishops could bleed. The fifth… we dare not speak his name. Soon we won’t remember it. But he waits. He will always wait.
Lore/Lore_15/Description: From the annals of the heathen.
Lore/Lore_15/Lore:
Conditions - harsh - cold - snow - cause unknown - graves - ruins - abandoned - Godless - suitable. Lightning - captured - power - uncontrollable - early experiments - failure - subject survival rate - none - better death than indoctrination

I will free them, I will free them all. Death to the Gods.
Lore/Lore_16/Description: A torn letter, stained with blood.
Lore/Lore_16/Lore: The blade fell and it did not die. It comes for me. It seeks to spill my blood as revenge for blood spilt. Gods, if there are any left to hear me - I beg it does not find me here.
Lore/Lore_17/Lore: Baraq was a dear friend of mine. He was a devoted carer of his herd, never abandoning them even in the worst of blizzards. He would play endless games of Flockade with me. <color=grey>We will not</color> have the chance to do so again...
Lore/Lore_18/Lore:
Aniel was a historian and a coward. I could not She could not stop the hunters when they came for the rest...

Here is my confession: when Woolhaven was burning, I found a baby in the rubble. I feared it would give me away with its cries... so I placed it in a basket and sailed it down the river. We will never know what became of it.
Lore/Lore_19/Lore:
Koka was almost made of stars, a beautiful and shining light amongst the pain and rot. She would gather us beneath the night sky and sing songs of praise to Yngya.

When the end was near and Koka realised what we must do... her poor children... her light went out forever. I wish I could suffer instead of those children...
Lore/Lore_2/Description: Writings from a time long passed.
Lore/Lore_2/Lore: Simple things… silly, almost… creatures seek protection in my shadow, pour faith into my soul and by their devotion I am changed. I was like them, once…
Lore/Lore_20/Lore:
Rami was easily outraged as a youth. They did not want to be isolated in this place. They did not understand the danger.

Then one day they left, and did not return for many years. When they did, they were changed; subdued and terribly burnt. They had apprenticed beneath a master smith in the hopes of making something that could save us... to fix what was broken...
Lore/Lore_21/Lore:
Chazaq loved his life here. He insisted we did not need the world, for we had Woolhaven. He kept the baskets full of flowers, and the plaza clean.

He was the one who prepared our graves, so we would have a place to rest when... and he ensured that Koka's grave would be big enough for their children, too. He deserves to be remembered kindly.
Lore/Lore_22/Lore:
Sariel was the High Disciple of Yngya, and Her confidante. He loved Her. When Yngya died, he was lost, as we all were. We are only sheep, after all - we need a leader. He did not see a way to salvation without Her. He did not see life as worth living. He did not see this world as worthy of existing.

He guides us, now. He will guide us to the end.
Lore/Lore_23/Description: Carved in a language almost lost.
Lore/Lore_23/Lore:
Cold Mother we give our thanks for the Haven You have gifted us here in the shadow of Your mountain.

Cold Mother by Your bell we are Called, by Your Crown we are protected.

Cold Mother may You watch over us from the Mountain Peak.
Lore/Lore_24/Description: Carved in a language almost lost.
Lore/Lore_24/Lore:
Cold Mother we pray that Evil be kept at bay, we pray our Paradise remain lost to those not of Wool and Bell, we pray You triumph in war against those who seek to use Your flock for own selfish gain.

Cold Mother we pray for Your victory over Chaos, Pestilence, Famine and War, Cold Mother we pray for Shelter to raise our young, Cold Mother we pray you return safe and whole to us.
Lore/Lore_25/Description: Carved in a language almost lost.
Lore/Lore_25/Lore: Cold Mother we pray Your return Cold Mother we pray Your return Cold Mother we pray Your return Cold Mother we pray Your return Cold Mother we pray You do not abandon us Cold Mother we pray Your return Cold Mother we pray Cold Mother we pray You stay, Cold Mother stay, Cold Mother stay, Cold Mother stay.
Lore/Lore_26/Description: From the annals of the heathen.
Lore/Lore_26/Lore: Make the specified adjustments - new Shards delivered - do not deviate - gauntlets yielding results - first subject disfigured - mute - remaining pups liberated intact - success. Once prototype complete - to my specification - do not deviate - you will be returned.
Lore/Lore_27/Description: From the annals of the heathen.
Lore/Lore_27/Lore: The disease spreads - consumes - burns - resistant to cure. Members of pack - fallen - despite attempts - more samples required. I will not - lose - this place - the pack - my mind - to this - to this - I did not - escape - Bishops - to fall - to Gods.
Lore/Lore_3/Description: Writings from a time long passed.
Lore/Lore_3/Lore:
I used to think them strange, these three feathered beasts, unworn and unweathered by the passage of time. To be keepers of Godly tools, and yet not be tempted to Godliness themselves - do they not hunger as we do?
Now, wisened in age, I understand. Hatched beneath the First, they crave no power, seek no other fulfillment, for it is not in their nature. And it is by nature that we must abide.
Lore/Lore_4/Description: Writings from a time long passed.
Lore/Lore_4/Lore: My pilgrimage has lead me thus, to the caverns of a Godly skull, remnants of a Great One now decaying into earth. The air here smells sweet, the soil rich and dark… I hear whispers, I feel watched, yet there is naught around, just these strange, small mushrooms, their spots almost like eyes… but that’s impossible…?
Lore/Lore_5/Description: Writings from a time long passed.
Lore/Lore_5/Lore:
I had not seen her in some dozen years, perhaps a score, perhaps a hundred. She is changed, alarmingly so, the mutilation of her body naught compared to the madness taking root in her mind. Her kin were indifferent. ‘Twas foreseen, the card reader said. I asked, what of her duty? What of the Crowns? What of her very nature?
And the smith answered: it is lost.
Lore/Lore_6/Description: Writings from a time long passed.
Lore/Lore_6/Lore: I have lived long, too long for simple memory and so I must continue to chronicle these histories. Followers rise, bloom, and die, like so much clover on the ground, and my troublesome peers, Gods by a right no longer divine, rise and fall like tides cut free from the moon. One came to my temple, young and ambitious and thirsty for war. I dismissed them. I will not abide such blasphemy.
Lore/Lore_7/Description: Writings from a time long passed.
Lore/Lore_7/Lore: Whispers reach my temple. Gods fallen, shrines crumbled, Followers taken, and Crowns simply gone. Our numbers are beginning to dwindle. I do not fear. I will swing my righteous axe, draw my zealous sword, and know that I walk with the blessing of the First at my brow. Heresy shall not be tolerated in these Lands.
Lore/Lore_8/Description: Writings from a time long passed.
Lore/Lore_8/Lore: Yngya cannot be found, and the leaves change no more. ‘Tis clear, now, that none shall survive this purging. The Owl has chosen a different tact, one I cannot condone; for regardless of what they threaten, I shall never relinquish my beliefs. They call me the greatest of fanatics, and perchance this is true: for I would rather perish than sacrifice my devotion. Great Ones, I am yours eternally.
Lore/Lore_9/Description: Writings from a time long passed.
Lore/Lore_9/Lore: He of havoc, he of blight; she of hunger, they of might. He that lays a soul to rest; five remain of hundreds blessed.
Lore/Lore_x/Description: Carved in a language almost lost.
Lore/Lore_x/Lore:
Cold Mother we pray Your forgiveness for we act without Your guidance, though You are no longer here to guide; Cold Mother we pray that though we may lose Your love, let acceptance rise in love’s place; Cold Mother we turn our faces from Nature for Nature has struck unjust, and Our justice will strike back.
Cold Mother, when the last does fall, let them heed Our call.

QUOTE/DLC_Intro: Last of the lambs, heed the mountain's call; deep in its heart, power awaits.
QUOTE/IntroQuote: Praise the Lamb, conduit to great power, promised liberator of The One Who Waits below.
QUOTE/IntroQuote2: Yet sacrificial beast, take heed; for a Crown cannot sit upon two brows.
QUOTE/Lore1: I await one who values truth over all else.
QUOTE/Lore2: It is done. Take this, and remember me.
QUOTE/QuoteBoss1: What is a Shepherd without a flock?
QUOTE/QuoteBoss2: And the Shepherd shall make a way in the wilderness; rivers in the desert; and light in the dark.
QUOTE/QuoteBoss3: Suffering shall turn to triumph; that which once did perish shall now prey.
QUOTE/QuoteBoss4: Lamb, once slaughtered in the name of the Captive God, ponder this; whose name does thou slaughter in now?
QUOTE/QuoteBoss5: Sacrifice reborn Vessel, ascend once more and take true form; no longer a servant, no less than a God.
QUOTE/QuoteBoss6: Shepherd of souls, guide them now into the After so they may not lose their way.
QUOTE/QuoteBoss7: By the Lamb may we live; and in time, by the Lamb may we die.
QUOTE/QuoteBoss8: Having witnessed such greatness, and in sharing this truth, the Gospel of the Lamb is born.
QUOTE/QuoteBoss9: Repent; for the Kingdom of the Lamb has arisen.

Collect horrifying new follower skins and decorations for your Cult.
