Traits/GrassEater/Description: <sprite name="icon_FaithUp"> No longer lose Faith when a follower eats a Grass Meal.
Traits/HateElderly/Description: <sprite name="icon_FaithUp"> Gain +10 Faith if an elder is sacrificed, murdered or consumed, but <sprite name="icon_FaithDown"> -20 Faith if an elder dies naturally.
Traits/Heavyweight/Description: Less likely to become Befuddled from drinks.
Traits/Hedonism/Description: Decreases productivity by 10% but increases <color=#FFD201>Sin</color> <sprite name="icon_SinDoctrine"> generation by 15%.
Traits/Immortal/Description: <sprite name="icon_FaithUp"> Will never reach old age.
Traits/InfusibleSnowman/Description: Snowlamb won't melt after winter ends.
Traits/Insomniac/Description: Sleeps during the day and works at night.
Traits/IronStomach/Description: <sprite name="icon_FaithUp"> Heals 15% faster when sick and in bed rest.
Traits/JiltedLover/Description: Angry after the divorce. Will not be told what to do.
Traits/Lazy/Description: <sprite name="icon_FaithDown"> Work and devotion generation speed reduced by 10%.
Traits/Libertarian/Description: <sprite name="icon_FaithUp"> Freedom above all else. Every day that begins without anyone in prison, gain +10 Faith.
Traits/LightningEnthusiast/Description: Higher chance of being struck by lightning. Won't die when struck.
Traits/Lightweight/Description: More likely to engage in debaucherous behaviour when Befuddled.
Traits/LockedLoyal/Description: Gains Loyalty each day they are in Prison.
Traits/LoveElderly/Description: <sprite name="icon_FaithUp"> Gain +5 Faith when a Follower becomes an elder.
Traits/LoveOfSickPeople/Description: <sprite name="icon_FaithUp"> Gain +5 Faith when another Cult member becomes ill.
Traits/Lumberjack/Decription: Specialises in working at Lumberjack Stations. They will chop trees and store the lumber for collection.
Traits/Lustful/Description: <sprite name="icon_FaithUp"> Very... affectionate towards other Followers.
Traits/MarriedJealous/Description: Will get into fights with other spouses.
Traits/MarriedMurderouslyJealous/Descrip: 25% more likely to murder other spouses in fights.
Traits/Masochistic/Description: Gains Sin each day they are in Prison.
Traits/MasterfulSnowman/Description: Perfectly made! Productivity is significantly increased.
Traits/Materialistic/Description: <sprite name="icon_FaithUp">Gain Faith when building better sleeping quarters.
Traits/MissionaryExcited/Description: 20% more likely to be successful in the Mating Tent.
Traits/MissionaryInspired/Description: All interactions with other Followers will be positive.
Traits/MissionaryTerrified/Description: Has seen too much. Will need to be specially healed.
Traits/MushroomBanned/Description: <sprite name="icon_FaithUp"> Work speed and devotion generation increased by 10% but <sprite name="icon_FaithDown"> 50% chance of Followers becoming sick after the Brainwashing ritual.
Traits/MushroomEncouraged/Description: <sprite name="icon_FaithUp"> Gain +20 Faith when Brainwashing Ritual is performed.
Traits/MusicLover/Description: <sprite name="icon_FaithUp"> Generates 200% Sin when using the <color=#FFD201>Drum Circle</color>.
Traits/Mutated/Description: Does not starve, freeze, dissent or become ill.
Traits/MutatedVisual/Description: A bit... odd looking, but will not spread Rot.
Traits/NaturallyObedient/Description: <sprite name="icon_FaithUp">On recruiting this Follower immediately gain +10 Faith.
Traits/Nudist/Description: <sprite name="icon_FaithUp"> Generates Loyalty 50% faster when Naked.
Traits/OverworkedParent/Description: Exhausted and likely to have negative interactions with other Followers.
Traits/Pacifist/Description: Does not fight with other Followers. Will break up Follower fights.
Traits/Polyamory/Description: Does not get jealous if the Lamb has more than 1 spouse.
Traits/ProudParent/Description: Affectionate to their child and proud to have made the Lamb a new Follower.
Traits/PureBlood_1/Description: The great grandchild of this Follower will receive the 'Chosen Child' trait.
Traits/PureBlood_2/Description: The grandchild of this Follower will receive the 'Chosen Child' trait.
Traits/PureBlood_3/Description: The child of this Follower will receive the 'Chosen Child' trait.
Traits/RejectRot/Description: Gain Faith when a <color=#FFD201>Rotten Follower</color> is killed.
Traits/RemoveRot/Description: Remove the <color=#FFD201>Rotten</color> Trait from Followers at the <color=#FFD201>Healing Bay</color>.
Traits/SacrificeEnthusiast/Description: <sprite name="icon_FaithUp">Gain +20 Faith when a Follower is sacrificed.
Traits/SeenGod/Description: Less likely to become possessed by Sin.
Traits/SermonEnthusiast/Description: <sprite name="icon_FaithUp"> Gain more Faith when you give a sermon.
Traits/Sickly/Description: <sprite name="icon_FaithDown">Heals 15% slower when sick and in bed rest.
Traits/Snorer/Description: Will wake nearby Followers with their snoring.
Traits/Spy/Description: Has not been indoctrinated into the Cult. Will try and take what they can.
Traits/Terrified/Description: <sprite name="icon_FaithDown">Sits in the corner and cries.
Traits/Unlawful/Description: Will break themselves and others out of prison.
Traits/ViolentExtremist/Description: Chance of <color=#FFD201>Sin</color> <sprite name="icon_SinDoctrine"> appearing as a reward from mini-bosses.
Traits/WinterBody/Description: Works 30% faster during winter but 20% slower during summer.
Traits/WinterExcited/Description: <sprite name="icon_FaithUp"> Gains +20 <color=#FFD201>Loyalty</color> at the start of winter.
Traits/Worker/Description: Will do the hard work required to keep a Cult running such as building and clearing weeds.
Traits/Worshipper/Description: Generates Devotion by worshipping at your shrine.
Traits/Zealous/Description: <sprite name="icon_FaithUp"> Ignores dissenters when they preach.
Traits/Zombie/Description: Corrupted by their resurrection. Will need to be specially healed.
Tutorial UI/Babies/Description: A Follower has been born into your Cult. They are yours to watch over.
Tutorial UI/Babies/Info1: Child Followers are much more impressionable and will level up each time you show them affection.
Tutorial UI/Babies/Info2: But if a child is neglected they will become jaded and leave the Cult when they reach adulthood.
Tutorial UI/Befuddled/Info1: Your Followers have been at the Drinkhouse. {0} of {1} Followers are Befuddled!
Tutorial UI/BlessedMeal/Description: You can now create 'Blessed' meals which will satisfy Follower's hunger significantly more.
Tutorial UI/BlessedMeal/Info1: When cooking, target the yellow area to bless the meal.
Tutorial UI/Blizzard/Description: A Blizzard is here! Not only will your base become colder, but something is... coming...
Tutorial UI/Blizzard/Info1: You must prepare an <color=#FFD201>offering</color> before the blizzard ends. If this offering is not fulfilled, your Cult and Followers will pay the price instead.
Tutorial UI/Blizzard/Info2: Build the <color=#FFD201>Table of Offerings</color> to make an offering and ensure your Cult and Followers will be left unharmed.
Tutorial UI/BlunderWeapon/Description: The Blunderbuss is a short-ranged, ammo-based weapon.
Tutorial UI/BlunderWeapon/Info1: It can tear through multiple nearby enemies, as well as knock them back.
Tutorial UI/BlunderWeapon/Info2: However, its range is limited - it will do more damage to closer targets, while targets further away might not feel a thing.
Tutorial UI/BurntFood/Description: You have burnt this meal and it cannot be eaten by your Followers. Clean away this unsightly mess.
Tutorial UI/BurntFood/Info1: Cook more food so your Followers actually have something to eat, and be more careful next time!
Tutorial UI/CommandmentStone/Description: You have found enough fragments to form a <color=#FFD201>Commandment Stone.</color>
Tutorial UI/CommandmentStone/Info1: <color=#FFD201>Commandment Stones</color> are used to declare new <color=#FFD201>Doctrines</color> for your Cult to follow.
Tutorial UI/CommandmentStone/Info2: Use the Altar in your Temple to declare a new <color=#FFD201>Doctrine</color> whenever you form a new <color=#FFD201>Commandment Stone.</color>
Tutorial UI/ContinueAdventureMap/Descrip: Now you have defeated the Bishop of this area you may continue onward.
Tutorial UI/ContinueAdventureMap/Info1: Greater rewards await the further you venture.
Tutorial UI/ContinueAdventureMap/Info2: But beware, if you don't have the <color=#FFD201>Omnipresence</color> Crown Ability you will not be able to return to the Cult until you reach another teleporter.
Tutorial UI/ContinueAdventureMap/Info3: Only continue onwards if you are prepared to leave your Cult for a little while longer.
Tutorial UI/CrystalDoctrine/Description: You have found enough fragments to form a <color=#20D1D6>Forgotten Commandment Stone.</color>
Tutorial UI/CrystalDoctrine/Info1: You can use <color=#20D1D6>Forgotten Commandment Stones</color> to declare Doctrines that you previously did not choose.
Tutorial UI/CrystalDoctrine/Info2: You can only do this for Doctrine categories that have already been completed.
Tutorial UI/CurseWheel/Description: You've unlocked a new <color=#FFD201>Curse.</color> Change between them using the <color=#FFD201>Curse Wheel.</color>
Tutorial UI/CurseWheel/Info1: Each new <color=#FFD201>Curse</color> is added to a slot on the <color=#FFD201>Curse Wheel</color>.
Tutorial UI/CurseWheel/Info2: Hold {0} to open the <color=#FFD201>Curse Wheel,</color> select your preferred curse then release {0} to equip.
Tutorial UI/DarknessWithin/Description: You have unlocked a new <color=#FFD201>Crown Ability.</color>
Tutorial UI/DarknessWithin/Info1: You will begin each new crusade with a Diseased Heart.
Tutorial UI/DarknessWithin/Info2: Diseased hearts damage all enemies in the room when you take a hit.
Tutorial UI/DeadFollower/Description: A Follower has died! Commiserations on your loss.
Tutorial UI/DeadFollower/Info1: Corpses are not good for sanitation and are likely to cause other Followers to get sick.
Tutorial UI/DeadFollower/Info2: You need to bury your Follower in a <color=#FFD201>Body Pit</color> or <color=#FFD201>Grave</color> to prevent them from going rotten.
Tutorial UI/DeadFollower/Info3: Of course, that is a lot of meat to just go to waste...
Tutorial UI/Demons/Description: <color=#FFD201>Followers</color> can be possessed by the soul of a <color=#FFD201>Demon</color> to fight by your side on your next crusade.
Tutorial UI/Demons/Info1: Convert a <color=#FFD201>Follower</color> into a <color=#FFD201>Demon</color> for extra firepower when entering your next crusade run.
Tutorial UI/Demons/Info2: <color=#FFD201>Demons</color> will help fight against <color=#FFD201>Enemies</color>when on a <color=#FFD201>Crusade</color>. They cannot be killed.
Tutorial UI/Demons/Info3: Once you have completed or failed a crusade run, the <color=#FFD201>Demon</color> will be converted back into a <color=#FFD201>Follower.</color>
Tutorial UI/Dissenter/Description: A Follower has begun <color=#FD1D03>Dissenting</color> against you. This happens when the Cult's <color=#FFD201>Faith</color> <sprite name="icon_Faith"> is too low.
Tutorial UI/Dissenter/Info1: A traitor is spreading falsehoods about you. <color=#FFD201>Other Followers</color> may also be led astray.
Tutorial UI/Dissenter/Info2: Re-educate them, or put them in <color=#FFD201>Prison</color> to bring them back in to the loving embrace of the Cult ... or just sacrifice them. You make the rules, after all.
Tutorial UI/Dissenter/Info3: Imprisoned Dissenters are considered <color=#FFD201>Guilty</color> by other Followers, meaning there will not be Faith penalties for <color=#FFD201>reeducating</color> them.
Tutorial UI/DivineInspiration/Descriptio: Collect Devotion <sprite name="icon_spirits"> from your Shrine. Once you collect enough you will unlock <color=#FFD201>Divine Inspiration.</color>
Tutorial UI/DivineInspiration/Info1: The more Followers worshipping at your shrine, the faster they will fill up. If the shrine is full, they will stop worshipping until it is emptied.
Tutorial UI/DivineInspiration/Info2: Once you have collected <color=#FFD201>Divine Inspiration</color> unlock new buildings for your Cult through the Shrine.
Tutorial UI/Faith/Description: Your Cult has a <color=#FFD201>Faith level</color> <sprite name="icon_Faith"> which is affected by your actions as leader, and whether or not your Followers are being well cared for. To keep it high perform <color=#FFD201>Rituals</color>, preach <color=#FFD201>Sermons</color>, cook <color=#FFD201>food</color> and build <color=#FFD201>shelters</color> for them.
Tutorial UI/Faith/Info1: You can see the <color=#FFD201>Faith</color> <sprite name="icon_Faith"> of your Cult at the top left of the screen.
Tutorial UI/Faith/Info2: Follower's productivity is tied to Faith. When it is high they will <color=#FFD201>work</color> harder and generate <color=#FFD201>devotion</color> <sprite name="icon_spirits"> more quickly.
Tutorial UI/Faith/Info3: When your Cult's faith becomes too low Followers may <color=#FFD201>dissent</color> and try to convince others to turn against you as well.
Tutorial UI/Fervor/Description: Fervour <sprite name="icon_blackSoul"> is the righteous anger earned by striking down non-believers and works like ammunition for your Curses.
Tutorial UI/Fervor/Info1: Fervour <sprite name="icon_blackSoul"> will drop when you slay an enemy. Collecting it refuels your Curses.
Tutorial UI/Fleeces/Description: You have found all four pieces of a <color=#FFD201>Holy Talisman.</color>
Tutorial UI/Fleeces/Info1: Talisman's are mystical relics that the Red Crown can use to unlock new <color=#FFD201>Fleeces.</color>
Tutorial UI/Fleeces/Info2: Unlock and equip <color=#FFD201>Fleeces</color> from the Altar in your <color=#FFD201>Temple.</color>
Tutorial UI/Fleeces_OLD/Info2: Unlock and equip <color=#FFD201>Fleeces</color> using the <color=#FFD201>Doctrine Book</color> at the altar in your <color=#FFD201>Temple.</color>
Tutorial UI/FollowerAction/Description: You have declared a Doctrine which has granted you a new Follower Action.
Tutorial UI/FollowerAction/Info1: When interacting with Followers this action will be available to you.
Tutorial UI/Food/Description: Your Followers need to eat and it's up to you to provide meals <sprite name="icon_Meal"> for them.
Tutorial UI/Food/Info1: The hunger of your Cult can be seen on the top left of the screen. When this gets too low, Followers will begin to starve.
Tutorial UI/Food/Info2: Find more food while crusading - pick routes that pass through foraging locations.
Tutorial UI/Food/Info3: Plant farms to grow your own food. Seeds can be purchased or found whilst crusading.
Tutorial UI/Freezing/Description: A Follower is <color=#FD1D03>freezing</color>. This happens during <color=#FFD201>winter</color> when Followers are not kept warm.
Tutorial UI/Freezing/Info1: Prevent Followers from freezing by making special <color=#FFD201>outfits</color> and keeping the <color=#FFD201>Furnace</color> full of <color=#FFD201>Rotburn</color>.
Tutorial UI/Freezing/Info2: Freezing Followers can be warmed using the <color=#FFD201>Baptismal Bath</color> or fed a meal made from <color=#FFD201>chillis</color>.
Tutorial UI/Freezing/Info3: If left untreated, freezing Followers will become <color=#FFD201>frozen solid</color>, and will not thaw until <color=#FFD201>winter ends</color>.
Tutorial UI/Furnace/Description: The <color=#FFD201>Rotburn Furnace</color> is used to keep your Cult warm and prevents Followers from <color=#FD1D03>freezing</color>.
Tutorial UI/Furnace/Info1: Depositing <color=#FFD201>Rotburn</color> will power the <color=#FFD201>Furnace</color>. But don't let it run out or your Cult will soon start to freeze!
Tutorial UI/GameOver/Description: Without a Cult, survival is impossible. You have two days to gain at least one Follower.
Tutorial UI/GameOver/Info1: If you fail to do so, death will be permanent and the game will come to an end.
Tutorial UI/HealingBay/Description: When assigned <color=#FFD201>bed rest, </color>sick Followers may visit an available <color=#FFD201>Healing Bay</color> to heal much faster than they otherwise would.
Tutorial UI/HealingBay/Info1: Place<color=#FFD201> flowers</color> <sprite name="icon_FlowerRed"> at the Healing Bay for Followers to heal considerably faster.
Tutorial UI/HealingBay/Info2: Poop, vomit and dead bodies cause illness to spread quickly throughout your Cult.
Tutorial UI/HealingBay/Info3: Cleaning messes and burying bodies will prevent the spread of illness.
Tutorial UI/HeavyAttacks/Description: Press the <color=#FFD201>Heavy Attack button</color> to perform heavy attacks.
Tutorial UI/HeavyAttacks/DescriptionTouc: Tap the <color=#FFD201>Heavy Attack button</color> to perform heavy attacks.
Tutorial UI/HeavyAttacks/Info1: Each weapon has a unique heavy attack for you to master.
Tutorial UI/Illness/Description: Unsanitary conditions at your Cult will cause your Followers to become sick.
Tutorial UI/Illness/Info1: If a Follower becomes sick, assign them to <color=#FFD201>Bed Rest</color> or they could die. Resting will allow them to slowly recover. <sprite name="icon_Sickness">
Tutorial UI/Illness/Info2: Poop, vomit and dead bodies cause illness to spread quickly throughout your Cult.
Tutorial UI/Illness/Info3: Cleaning messes and burying bodies will prevent the spread of illness.
Tutorial UI/Injured/Info1: Your Followers have been getting into fights. {0} of {1} Followers are injured!
Tutorial UI/JobBoards/Description: There's a lot to be done in Woolhaven! Each merchant will have a <color=#FFD201>Quest Board</color> of tasks you can complete.
Tutorial UI/JobBoards/Info1: You must <color=#FFD201>track the quest</color> from the Quest Board before beginning. Once complete, return to claim your reward.
Tutorial UI/LevellingUp/Description: Increase a Follower's <color=#FFD201>Loyalty</color> to level them up, and they will reward you with Devotion <sprite name="icon_spirits"> and a Commandment Stone Fragment! <sprite name="icon_DoctrineStone">
Tutorial UI/LevellingUp/Description_OLD: Increase a Follower's <color=#FFD201>Loyalty</color> and they will eventually give you Devotion <sprite name="icon_spirits"> and a Commandment Stone Fragment <sprite name="icon_DoctrineStone">
Tutorial UI/LevellingUp/Info1: To increase their loyalty, you can give a Follower a <color=#FFD201>blessing</color> once a day when you interact with them.
Tutorial UI/LevellingUp/Info2: You can also give them <color=#FFD201>gifts,</color> complete <color=#FFD201>quests</color> for them, perform <color=#FFD201>Sermons</color> and many other actions.
Tutorial UI/LevellingUp/Info2_OLD: You can also give them <color=#FFD201>gifts</color> and complete <color=#FFD201>quests</color> they ask you to do.
Tutorial UI/LevellingUp/Info3: Each time a Follower levels up, they will generate additional <color=#FFD201>Devotion</color> <sprite name="icon_spirits"> when at a Sermon or worshipping at the Shrine. So be sure to cultivate their <color=#FFD201>Loyalty.</color>
Tutorial UI/LevellingUp/Info3_OLD: You can also perform Sermons and many other actions to increase their <color=#FFD201>Loyalty.</color>
Tutorial UI/LevellingUp_OLD/Description: Increase a Follower's <color=#FFD201>Loyalty</color> and they will eventually give you a large reward.
Tutorial UI/LevellingUp_OLD/Info3: Once completely <color=#FFD201>loyal,</color> a Follower will grant you a large reward.
Tutorial UI/Midwinter/Description: It's <color=#FFD201>midwinter</color>! Every winter, one night will be longer than the rest.
Tutorial UI/Midwinter/Info1: The <color=#FFD201>Midwinter Celebration</color> ritual will only be available on the longest night. Celebrate with your Followers!
Tutorial UI/Missionaries/Description: Send <color=#FFD201>Followers</color> away on missions to collect <color=#FFD201>Resources.</color>
Tutorial UI/Missionaries/Info1: Missionaries allow you to send your <color=#FFD201>Followers</color> off to retrieve more <color=#FFD201>Resources</color>, or even recruit <color=#FFD201>Followers.</color>
Tutorial UI/Missionaries/Info2: But be careful! Missions may <color=#FFD201>fail</color>, and can result in your <color=#FFD201>Follower dying.</color>
Tutorial UI/Missionaries/Info3: Beware: The more often a Follower has gone on a mission, the higher the chance of something going wrong!
Tutorial UI/MonsterHeart/Description: You have taken the beating heart of a heretic.
Tutorial UI/MonsterHeart/Info1: The Red Crown can feast upon this heart to unlock new Crown Abilities. Visit the Altar in your Temple to unleash the true power of the Red Crown.
Tutorial UI/MonsterHeart_OLD/Info1: The Red Crown can feast upon this heart and unlock new powers. Visit the shrine at Ratau’s hut to unleash the true power of the Red Crown.
Tutorial UI/MutatedFollower/Description: Rotten Followers may be ugly, but they offer unique advantages to your Cult.
Tutorial UI/MutatedFollower/Info1: Rotten Followers will not <color=#FFD201>starve, dissent, freeze,</color> become <color=#FFD201>ill</color> or reach <color=#FFD201>old age</color>. But they will eventually Rot away.
Tutorial UI/MutatedFollower/Info2: Additionally, Rotten Followers will pray to the <color=#FFD201>Rotten Yngya Shrine</color> to unlock special rewards.
Tutorial UI/NewRecipe/Info1: New recipe's can be found by <color=#FFD201>mixing</color> together different <color=#FFD201>ingredients.</color>
Tutorial UI/NewRecipe/Info2: Meals provide different levels of <color=#FFD201>hunger</color> and <color=#FFD201>Faith.</color>
Tutorial UI/NewRecipe/Info3: Select the <color=#FFD201>recipe tab</color> to choose a recipe. The best ingredients for the meal will be automatically selected, so long as you have enough of them.
Tutorial UI/Omnipresence/Description: You have unlocked a new <color=#FFD201>Crown Ability.</color>
Tutorial UI/Omnipresence/Info1: Focus whilst on a Crusade run to instantly return to the base.
Tutorial UI/Overheating/Description: A Follower is <color=#FF2320>Overheating</color>. This happens when the Cult's <color=#FFD201>Temperature</color> <sprite name="icon_Temperature"> is too low.
Tutorial UI/Overheating/Info1: Overheating followers will soon overheat to death. Cool them down by changing their clothing into something cooler.
Tutorial UI/PerformAnyRitual: Perform any Ritual in your Temple
Tutorial UI/PerformanceMode/Info: <color=#FFD201>High Performance Mode</color> has been enabled to optimise your gameplay. It can be disabled in the <color=#FFD201>Games</color> menu under <color=#FFD201>Settings</color>.
Tutorial UI/PlayerExhausted/Info1: If you don't sleep now you will die, there's no second chances!
Tutorial UI/PlayerHunger/Description: It's time for you to eat some of that yummy (and gross) food you cook for your followers!
Tutorial UI/PlayerHunger/Info1: Eat to keep your hunger bar full, if your hunger bar depletes to empty you will die, permanently!
Tutorial UI/PlayerLevelUp/Description: Through the faith of your Followers you grow stronger.
Tutorial UI/PlayerLevelUp/Info1: Performing Sermons will draw power from them and allow you to unlock new abilities, weapons and curses.
Tutorial UI/PlayerLevelUp/Info2: Followers with a higher Loyalty level will generate more <color=#FFD201>Devotion</color> <sprite name="icon_spirits">. Therefore, the more Followers you have and the more Loyal they are, the quicker you will gain new <color=#FFD201>abilities.</color>
Tutorial UI/PlayerSleep/Description: Claim a bed for yourself and sleep among your followers whenever you'd like.
Tutorial UI/PlayerSleep/Info1: You must stay rested, if your sleepyness bar depletes to empty you will die, permanently!
Tutorial UI/PlayerStarving/Info1: If you don't eat now you will die, there's no second chances!
Tutorial UI/Pleasure/Description: <color=#FFD201>Sin</color> can now be generated by Followers when doing certain activities.
Tutorial UI/Pleasure/Info1: Once a Follower has generated enough <color=#FFD201>Sin</color>, they will be summoned to the <color=#FFD201>Sin Totem</color> for you to absolve them, and collect their <color=#FFD201>Sin.</color>
Tutorial UI/Proximity_Furnace/Descriptio: <color=#FFD201>Heaters</color> spread the heat of the <color=#FFD201>Rotburn Furnace</color>, thawing snowed under structures within a range.
Tutorial UI/Proximity_Furnace/Info1: Heaters are powered by the <color=#FFD201>Rotburn Furnace</color>, and will only work when the Furnace is fuelled.
Tutorial UI/Purgatory/Description: You may only enter Purgatory once a day.
Tutorial UI/Purgatory/Info1: When in Purgatory time will pause at your Cult.
Tutorial UI/RefiningResources/Info1: Consecrated resources are made up of base resources.
Tutorial UI/RefiningResources/Info2: Unlock and build a <color=#FFD201>Refinery</color> to be able to consecrate resources.
Tutorial UI/RefiningResources/Info3: Queue up an order at the Refinery and a <color=#FFD201>Follower</color> will automatically come to consecrate the resources for you.
Tutorial UI/Relics/Description: <color=#FFD201>Relics</color> are powerful items imbued with the power of Faith. They can be used to perform attacks or special actions.
Tutorial UI/Relics/Info1: <color=#FFD201>Relics</color> can be used once they are fully charged. <color=#FFD201>Charge</color> them by dealing damage to non-believers.
Tutorial UI/Relics/Info2: Some <color=#FFD201>Relics</color> can be used multiple times, while others are <color=#FFD201>Fragile</color> and can only be used once.
Tutorial UI/Resurrection/Description: You have unlocked a new <color=#FFD201>Crown Ability.</color>
Tutorial UI/Resurrection/Info1: Death is no longer the end. When killed on a crusade you may sacrifice a Follower to be resurrected and continue your run.
Tutorial UI/Rituals/DeleteInfo2: Indoctrinate more Followers to unlock the <color=#FFD201>Faith of the Flock</color> ritual.
Tutorial UI/Rituals/DeleteInfo3: Rituals also require <sprite name="icon_monsterHeart"> from defeated bosses and <sprite name="icon_bones"> from fallen enemies.
Tutorial UI/Rituals/Description: Perform <color=#FFD201>Rituals</color> in the Temple. These usually raise <color=#FFD201>Faith</color> <sprite name="icon_Faith"> or help you solve problems in the Cult.
Tutorial UI/Rituals/Info1: <color=#FFD201>Rituals</color> are performed using the bones <sprite name="icon_bones"> of your fallen enemies.
Tutorial UI/Rituals/Info2: After slaying a non-believer, desecrate their bodies to gather their bones, and use them to perform dark rituals at your Temple.
Tutorial UI/Rituals_OLD/Description: Performing <color=#FFD201>Rituals</color> in the Temple is the quickest way to become more powerful and solve problems in your Cult.
Tutorial UI/Rituals_OLD/Info1: Perform <color=#FFD201>Faith of the Flock</color> to permanently gain more <color=#FFD201>hearts,</color>and unlock devastating new <color=#FFD201>Curses</color> and <color=#FFD201>Weapons</color>.
Tutorial UI/Rituals_OLD/Info2: Unlock other Rituals by performing Sermons. Each Ritual will cost <sprite name="icon_bones"> from fallen enemies.
Tutorial UI/ShieldWeapon/Description: The Shield can be used to block and deflect enemy attacks.
Tutorial UI/ShieldWeapon/Info1: To raise your shield, hold the attack button. A raised shield will protect you from a limited number of enemy attacks and projectiles.
Tutorial UI/ShieldWeapon/Info2: Once the shield has taken too many hits, it will no longer protect you, and you will have to raise it again.
Tutorial UI/ShieldedEnemies/Description: Enemies holding shields will resist damage until their shield is broken. Use a <color=#FFD201>Heavy Attack</color> to break enemy shields.
Tutorial UI/ShieldedEnemies/Info1: Press the <color=#FFD201>Heavy Attack button</color> to perform heavy attacks.
Tutorial UI/Sin/Description: You can now know how <color=#FFD201>Sinful</color> a Follower has been. Once they have <color=#FFD201>Sinned</color> enough they will become consumed by it.
Tutorial UI/Sin/Info1: <color=#FFD201>Absolve</color> these Followers and harvest their <color=#FFD201>Sin</color> <sprite name="icon_SinDoctrine"> which can be used to improve your <color=#FFD201>Temple</color> - and more!
Tutorial UI/Sin/Info2: Generate <color=#FFD201>Sin</color> <sprite name="icon_SinDoctrine"> through <color=#FFD201>Rituals,</color> opening the <color=#FFD201>Drinkhouse,</color> and dancing at the <color=#FFD201>Drum Circle.</color>
Tutorial UI/Surveillance/Description: The <color=#FFD201>Surveillance Tower</color> allows you to learn every little secret your Followers may be hiding.
Tutorial UI/Surveillance/Info1: Interact with the <color=#FFD201>Surveillance Tower</color> to see an overview of the Cult as a whole.
Tutorial UI/Surveillance/Info2: You can now interact with Followers to <color=#FFD201>read their thoughts,</color> as well as see how hungry, tired or sick they are.
Tutorial UI/TheHunger/Description: You have unlocked a new <color=#FFD201>Crown Ability.</color>
Tutorial UI/TheHunger/Info1: Once a day eat a meal <sprite name="icon_Meal"> to receive a <sprite name="icon_blueheart">
Tutorial UI/Traits/Description: You have declared a Doctrine which has imbued your Followers with a new <color=#FFD201>Trait.</color>
Tutorial UI/Traits/Info1: This <color=#FFD201>Trait</color> will be applied to all members of the Cult, and will change how their <color=#FFD201>Faith</color> <sprite name="icon_Faith"> is affected by events.
Tutorial UI/Twitch/Description: Cult of the Lamb Twitch Integration
Tutorial UI/Twitch/Info1: Viewers can spend Channel Points which fill up your Twitch Totem Bar. When this bar is full you will receive a reward!
Tutorial UI/Twitch/Info2: Help or Hinder events will happen automatically. They allow viewers to vote on either giving you a bonus or punishing you!
Tutorial UI/Twitch/Info3: Allow viewers to enter a raffle to create your next follower. The follower will be designed by the viewer and will display their name above them at all times.
Tutorial UI/Twitch_2/Description: Viewers will now be able to see all of your Cult followers on Twitch within the Extension. You can now have viewers vote on which follower to sacrifice, send to the fight pit, marry, and many more!
Tutorial UI/Twitch_2/Info1: Using Channel Points, viewers with an in-game follower will now be able to talk to you! Make sure to go to the Extension configuration screen on Twitch to enable the Channel Points reward.
Tutorial UI/Twitch_2_ComingSoon/Descript: Viewers will soon be able to see all of your Cult followers on Twitch within the Extension. You can soon have viewers vote on which follower to sacrifice, send to the fight pit, marry, and many more!
Tutorial UI/Twitch_2_ComingSoon/Info1: Using Channel Points, viewers with an in-game follower will soon be able to talk to you! Make sure to go to the Extension configuration screen on Twitch to enable the Channel Points reward.
Tutorial UI/Twitch_3/Description: Twitch Integration has reached mobile devices! Viewers will now be able to interact with the integration on the go.
Tutorial UI/Twitch_3/Info1: Additions to existing features include the option for viewers to add clothing to their Follower, as well as new Help or Hinder choices.
Tutorial UI/Twitch_4/Description: Twitch Integration improvements! We have improved the overall health and flow of the Twitch integration.
Tutorial UI/Twitch_4/Info1: You can also now play Knucklebones against Twitch Chat! Build the Knucklebones Table or head to Ratau's shack to play!
Tutorial UI/WeaponWheel/Description: You've unlocked a new <color=#FFD201>Weapon.</color> Change between them using the <color=#FFD201>Weapon Wheel.</color>
Tutorial UI/WeaponWheel/Info1: Each new <color=#FFD201>Weapon</color> is added to a slot on the <color=#FFD201>Weapon Wheel.<color>
Tutorial UI/WeaponWheel/Info2: Hold {0} to open the wheel then select your preferred weapon and release {0} to equip.
Tutorial UI/WeatherVane/Description: The <color=#FFD201>Weather Vane</color> can be used to consult the heavens and learn of changes to the weather.
Tutorial UI/WeatherVane/Info1: It will tell you when the seasons will change and how long they will last, giving you time to prepare.
Tutorial UI/WeatherVane/Info2: The oncoming <color=#FFD201>Winter</color> could be mild, moderate or severe.
Tutorial UI/WeatherVane/Info3: The <color=#FFD201>Weather Vane</color> will also notify you when a <color=#FFD201>Blizzard</color> is on its way!
Tutorial UI/Wedding/Info1: Everyone enjoyed the <color=#FFD201>wedding</color> and you have raised the Faith of the Cult.
Tutorial UI/Wedding/Info2: You can <color=#FFD201>marry</color> as many Followers as you like. It's your Cult, after all.
Tutorial UI/Wedding/Info3: However, your spouses will become increasingly <color=#FFD201>jealous</color> every time you remarry.
Tutorial UI/Winter/Description: <color=#FFD201>Winter</color> has been awoken. While Followers will enjoy the snow, they must be kept <color=#FFD201>fed and warm.</color>
Tutorial UI/Winter/Info1: During winter, <color=#FFD201>Farm Plots</color> will freeze and seeds will not grow. Food must be <color=#FFD201>managed carefully</color>.
Tutorial UI/Winter/Info2: If Followers are not kept warm, they will become too cold to work and worship.
Tutorial UI/WinterAbility/Description: You have unlocked a new <color=#FFD201>Crown Ability.</color>
Tutorial UI/WinterAbility/Info1: You can now enable and disable <color=#FFD201>Winter</color> at the <color=#FFD201>Yngya Shrine</color> in Woolhaven.
Tutorial UI/WinterOver/Description: Winter has ended! Your Followers will no longer freeze, and crops will grow... but winter will always return.
Tutorial UI/WinterOver/Info1: Use this time to prepare yourself for the cold. Stock up on <color=#FFD201>food</color>, <color=#FFD201>Rotburn</color>, and anything else you may need!
Tutorial UI/Winter_1/Description: <color=#FFD201>Winter</color> has gotten stronger! If the Cult Warmth drops too low, Followers may freeze.
Tutorial UI/Winter_1/Info1: Make sure to fuel the <color=#FFD201>Rotburn Furnace</color> to prevent Followers from becoming <color=#FFD201>frozen</color>.
Tutorial UI/Winter_2/Description: <color=#FFD201>Winter</color> rages, and the Cult must weather the storm!
Tutorial UI/Winter_2/Description_OLD: <color=#FFD201>Winter</color> has gotten stronger! The increased cold means structures are at risk of becoming snowed under. Build <color=#FFD201>Proximity Heaters</color> nearby to prevent this.
Tutorial UI/Winter_2/Info1: Blizzards may occur and wreak havoc in your base. Fill the <color=#FFD201>Furnace</color> in order to dispel them.
Tutorial UI/Winter_2/Info1_OLD: The thick snow will provide cover for wolves to hunt your Ranch Animals, so keep an eye out!
Tutorial UI/Winter_3/Description: <color=#FFD201>Winter</color> grows stronger. Stockpile Rotburn and food to make sure your Cult is taken care of.
Tutorial UI/Winter_3/Info1: Wolves will use the snow as a cover to attack <color=#FFD201>ranch animals</color> - keep an eye out so you can spank them away!
Tutorial UI/Winter_4/Description: <color=#FFD201>Winter</color> has gotten stronger! Buildings in your Cult may become <color=#FFD201>snowed under</color>.
Tutorial UI/Winter_4/Info1: Build <color=#FFD201>Heaters</color> around your Cult to prevent this, otherwise they cannot be used.
Tutorial UI/Winter_5/Description: <color=#FFD201>Winter</color> is howling! Blizzards will occur more often.
Tutorial UI/Winter_5/Info1: Lightning may strike, which can destroy buildings and kill Followers if you're not prepared.
Tutorial UI/Wool/Description: The residents of <color=#FFD201>Woolhaven</color> will only trade in Wool.
Tutorial UI/Wool/Info1: Get Wool by <color=#FFD201>shearing</color> Ranch Animals. Use it to buy new <color=#FFD201>Ranch Animals</color>, <color=#FFD201>Tarot Cards</color>, <color=#FFD201>Fleeces</color>, and more!
